title: Product Engineer (all levels)
description:
I quit medicine because I kept watching patients die needlessly, for avoidable reasons. In almost every case, the medical knowledge and clinicians were there. It was the system that failed: the way information moved, decisions got routed, and fragmented teams and data turned solvable problems into tragedy.

I started Anima to change that.

Our mission is human wellbeing, and we believe personalised medicine will transform it. Our founding insight is that getting there requires a system that learns continuously from care and its outcomes, optimising for human wellbeing. Building that learning engine is the opportunity at the heart of Anima.

We're now in 1,000+ clinics across 5 product lines, serving more than 25% of the UK population. We are cash flow positive, growing fast, and have a tight crew of ~45 people who care deeply for each other and the mission. Everyone has real ownership and a voice in decisions.

Multiple trillion-dollar companies will be built in healthcare over the next two decades. We intend to be one of them. 

If you want to work on problems where the stakes are high, you belong at Anima. Your work here will save lives.

-- Shun

Long before the "vertical AI" craze, we were obsessed with active reinforcement learning—a niche field in 2021 that the world, pre-ChatGPT, largely ignored.

Our trajectory has been unwavering since our YC application: achieving the "holy grail" of personalized medicine and deep phenotyping. This is powered by our proprietary active learning architecture - a system we codified in a 2021 patent that anticipated the Sparse Mixture of Experts (MoE) and active learning loops now foundational to modern LLMs.

While others are just arriving at the party, we’ve spent years executing a plan to build what is now one of the world’s largest, highest-quality labeled datasets.

We’re looking for someone who 

- 
Has a track record of relentless shipping.

- 
Has proven ability to navigate ambiguity and tackle novel technical challenges from conception to production.

- 
Has strong CS Fundamentals. A deep understanding of data structures, algorithms (e.g., breadth-first search), and first-principles thinking to solve complex product problems.

- 
Is expert-level in TypeScript (TS). Proficiency in building type-safe, scalable applications. You are a full-stack expert in the JavaScript/Node.js ecosystem with a pragmatic approach to tech debt and tool selection.

- 
Has hands-on expertise with React, Angular, or Node.js, with the ability to move between frontend and backend as needed.

- 
Has experience architecting on AWS (specifically Lambda, DynamoDB, SQS, and CloudFormation) or a proven "hungry to learn" mindset regarding serverless infrastructure.

- 
Is disciplined towards best practice version control, CI/CD and code extensibility. Values interface safety through dimensionality reduction at interfaces.

- 
Is obsessive about UX and optimises for this over arbitrary technical goals.

- 
Is driven, impatient to grow and wants their shot to change the world.

We hire at all levels: our team has new grads and product leaders with 20 years experience.

What to expect in the role 

- 
You’ll work with an incredibly smart team. Like Michael who built a working CPU from logic dates at age 16 and co-founded YC-backed Embark Trucks, the first self-driving vehicle on Canadian roads. Or Souradip, who built an acoustic fall detector using on-device deep learning; he’s also an MB/PhD from Cambridge who’s published in top medical journals.

- 
You’ll own your projects end to end and ship fast. Like Alex who built ‘Slack for medical teams’ supporting 1000s of channels per organisation and a real time single source of truth for patient data in 4 weeks. Or Dennis who built and shipped a lightning fast cloud document library for clinics in a few days with You’ll work on a well-established stack that’s already highly scalable, cost effective, secure and performant with minimal to zero ops.

- 
You’ll learn new technologies; whatever is needed to solve the problem. We are tech agonistic, and collectively choose the best tools for the job. We’re constantly looking to maximise our productivity and minimise what we call “discounted dev time cost” for shipping features.

Our current stack 

We have 2 separate fully functional web apps in prod: one for clinical users and one for patients. Angular, React and Electron, Mixpanel/Posthog for analytics, a fully serverless backend in AWS (Cognito, Appsync GraphQL, Lambda, DynamoDB). We have good functional & unit test coverage and CI/CD.

What we offer

Anima should be where you do your life’s best work. We support that with:

- 
Time off: 25 days’ annual leave plus 8 UK public holidays, with flexible additional time off.

- 
Health cover: private medical, dental, vision and mental health insurance.

- 
Parental leave: 12 weeks’ maternity leave at full pay, rising to 24 weeks after two years; 4 weeks’ paternity leave at full pay.

- 
Pension: 4% employer contributions, with salary sacrifice and 100% of the employer National Insurance savings passed on to you.

- 
Learning: £1,000 annual budget for your development.

- 
Fitness: gym subscription matching up to £50 per month.

- 
Equipment: a high-spec MacBook and a home office budget.

- 
Time together: two full-team off-sites each year, previous destinations include Mykonos and Mexico.

- 
Farringdon office: a beautiful new London HQ, with most of the team together at least twice a week.

Everyone is welcome at Anima. We strongly believe in building a diverse and inclusive team. If you’re excited by our mission and believe you could do this work well, we’d love to hear from you, even if your experience doesn’t match every point above. If adjustments would help you participate fully in the interview process, please let us know.

description:
Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X . 

We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

This is a remote opportunity and we would be interested in applications from the UK, Ireland, Sweden, Spain and Germany. 

The opportunity: 

Grafana Labs is building a native experimentation platform: a Grafana app that lets teams define A/B tests, connect them to feature flags and product telemetry, and get trustworthy, statistically sound answers about what their changes actually did.

It started as a hackathon project and is now used by Grafana engineering and product teams in our internal environment to run real experiments. The next step is to make it a first-class product: one we rely on every day internally and, over time, one we offer to Grafana Cloud customers alongside Frontend Observability, Session Replay and our other user-experience capabilities.

You'll join the Product Analytics team , a group of highly technical product analysts who help teams across Grafana understand how our products are used and run experiments on them. As the team's dedicated software engineer, you'll own the engineering of the experimentation app and have a lot of influence over where it goes. You'll partner closely with data scientists on the statistics, data engineers on event pipelines and the data warehouse, software engineers across Grafana on feature flags, Frontend Observability and the App Platform, and product stakeholders who rely on experiment results to make decisions. This is a hands-on engineering role that ships production code. It is not an analyst role.

About the product: 

The experimentation app is built on the Grafana App Platform:

- Frontend: a TypeScript and React app plugin using @grafana/ui, plus a custom datasource plugin that powers experiment statistics panels.

- Backend: Go, built with the Grafana App SDK. Experiments are Kubernetes-style custom resources defined in CUE, with an operator, admission webhooks, and support for declarative, GitOps-style management.

- Feature flags: integration with OpenFeature and the OpenFeature Remote Evaluation Protocol (OFREP) , Grafana's multi-tenant feature toggle service, and an embedded GO Feature Flag evaluator.

- Statistics engine: a Bayesian analysis engine (TypeScript, with a Go port) that produces a direction-aware verdict per metric, probability to be best, credible intervals, expected loss and sample-size recommendations.

- Data: experiment exposure and outcome events flow from product instrumentation through RudderStack into BigQuery, or from Grafana Faro into Loki, and are queried live through Grafana datasources.

- AI: experiment authoring assisted by Grafana Assistant , which discovers relevant data and drafts the experiment configuration for a human to review.

What You’ll be doing: 

- Evolve the experimentation app from internal tool to product. Full ownership of features end to end across the React frontend and Go backend, from problem framing and design through rollout, measurement and iteration.

- Build the experimentation experience. Develop intuitive workflows for defining hypotheses, configuring experiments and metrics, managing their lifecycle, and exploring results. Make these experiences useful for product managers and analysts as well as engineers.

- Make instrumentation easier to adopt and trust . Evolve the experimentation SDK and its OpenFeature and Faro integrations. Help teams connect variant assignment, actual exposure, and outcome events with consistent identity and event contracts.

- Connect experiments to the rest of Grafana’s user-experience stack. Integrate with Grafana Faro and Frontend Observability so flag exposures and outcomes are captured automatically, and link experiment results to Session Replay and critical user journeys so teams can see why a variant won, not only that it won.

- Harden the statistics and analysis path. Work with our data analysts to extend the statistics engine, and make analysis scalable, cost-aware and correct. Examples include moving computation server-side, scheduled analysis, alerting on experiment health, and guardrails against misleading results.

- Use AI where it genuinely helps. Extend the Grafana Assistant integration for authoring, explaining and reporting on experiments.

- Raise the engineering bar. Mentor teammates, including analysts who contribute code, through code review, pairing and design docs. Write the architecture decision records (ADRs), docs and demos that help other teams adopt experimentation.

- Own what you ship. Take part in on-call for the services you build, and support the internal teams that run experiments on them.

We invest heavily in developer productivity. You can use modern AI coding assistants as part of your daily workflow (your choice of tools, within security guidelines), backed by a company-funded usage budget so you can iterate quickly without unnecessary friction. We encourage pragmatic AI-assisted development: faster prototyping, test generation, refactors, documentation, and incident follow-ups, always with strong code review and quality standards. You’ll also have access to the latest frontier models from OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google.

What makes you a great fit: 

We highly value people who are intellectually curious, default to transparency, have a strong bias towards action, and are kind and enjoy working as a team.

- Strong full-stack engineering experience. You’ve built and operated production web applications with TypeScript and React, and backend services in Go (or a similar language, with willingness to work in Go). You value maintainability, automated testing and secure development practices.

- Experience building an in-house platform or integrating existing experimentation and A/B testing platform (for example Statsig, Eppo, GrowthBook, Optimizely, LaunchDarkly experiments, or an in-house platform).

- Product and data intuition. You care whether what you shipped actually moved the needle, and you’re comfortable working with event data, SQL and data warehouses such as BigQuery.

- Technical ownership. You’ve delivered complex projects with minimal supervision, broken them into short feedback loops (analyze, design, ship an MVP, learn, iterate), and helped teammates work more effectively.

- Operational responsibility. You’ve been on call, supported software in production, and know how to make systems observable and debuggable.

- Pragmatic AI usage. You use AI coding tools thoughtfully, validate their output, and share practices that improve the team’s speed and quality.

- Clear communication. You can explain technical and statistical tradeoffs to engineers, analysts and product managers in a fully remote, asynchronous environment.

Bonus Points For: 

- Hands-on experience with feature flags and OpenFeature.

- A working understanding of experiment statistics: Bayesian or frequentist testing, sample sizing, variance reduction, and common pitfalls such as peeking and sample ratio mismatch.

- Experience with Kubernetes concepts: custom resources, operators, admission webhooks, GitOps.

- Experience building Grafana plugins or apps, or with the Grafana App SDK or Scenes.

- Familiarity with frontend observability and product analytics tooling, such as Grafana Faro, RUM, session replay, RudderStack or Segment.

- Open source contribution or maintainership.

- Experience as a user of Grafana, Prometheus, Loki or Tempo, whether at work or on a homelab.

The opportunity: 

Grafana Labs is building a native experimentation platform: a Grafana app that lets teams define A/B tests, connect them to feature flags and product telemetry, and get trustworthy, statistically sound answers about what their changes actually did.

It started as a hackathon project and is now used by Grafana engineering and product teams in our internal environment to run real experiments. The next step is to make it a first-class product: one we rely on every day internally and, over time, one we offer to Grafana Cloud customers alongside Frontend Observability, Session Replay and our other user-experience capabilities.

You'll join the Product Analytics team , a group of highly technical product analysts who help teams across Grafana understand how our products are used and run experiments on them. As the team's dedicated software engineer, you'll own the engineering of the experimentation app and have a lot of influence over where it goes. You'll partner closely with data scientists on the statistics, data engineers on event pipelines and the data warehouse, software engineers across Grafana on feature flags, Frontend Observability and the App Platform, and product stakeholders who rely on experiment results to make decisions. The experimentation app is built on the Grafana App Platform:

- Frontend: a TypeScript and React app plugin using @grafana/ui, plus a custom datasource plugin that powers experiment statistics panels.

- Backend: Go, built with the Grafana App SDK. Experiments are Kubernetes-style custom resources defined in CUE, with an operator, admission webhooks, and support for declarative, GitOps-style management.

- Feature flags: integration with OpenFeature and the OpenFeature Remote Evaluation Protocol (OFREP) , Grafana's multi-tenant feature toggle service, and an embedded GO Feature Flag evaluator.

- Statistics engine: a Bayesian analysis engine (TypeScript, with a Go port) that produces a direction-aware verdict per metric, probability to be best, credible intervals, expected loss and sample-size recommendations.

- Data: experiment exposure and outcome events flow from product instrumentation through RudderStack into BigQuery, or from Grafana Faro into Loki, and are queried live through Grafana datasources.

- AI: experiment authoring assisted by Grafana Assistant , which discovers relevant data and drafts the experiment configuration for a human to review.

What You’ll be doing: 

- Evolve the experimentation app from internal tool to product. Full ownership of features end to end across the React frontend and Go backend, from problem framing and design through rollout, measurement and iteration.

- Build the experimentation experience. Develop intuitive workflows for defining hypotheses, configuring experiments and metrics, managing their lifecycle, and exploring results. Make these experiences useful for product managers and analysts as well as engineers.

- Make instrumentation easier to adopt and trust . Evolve the experimentation SDK and its OpenFeature and Faro integrations. Help teams connect variant assignment, actual exposure, and outcome events with consistent identity and event contracts.

- Connect experiments to the rest of Grafana’s user-experience stack. - Raise the engineering bar. Mentor teammates, including analysts who contribute code, through code review, pairing and design docs. Write the architecture decision records (ADRs), docs and demos that help other teams adopt experimentation.

- Own what you ship. Take part in on-call for the services you build, and support the internal teams that run experiments on them.

- Experience building an in-house platform or integrating existing experimentation and A/B testing platform (for example Statsig, Eppo, GrowthBook, Optimizely, LaunchDarkly experiments, or an in-house platform).

- Product and data intuition. You care whether what you shipped actually moved the needle, and you’re comfortable working with event data, SQL and data warehouses such as BigQuery.

- Technical ownership. You’ve delivered complex projects with minimal supervision, broken them into short feedback loops (analyze, design, ship an MVP, learn, iterate), and helped teammates work more effectively.

title: Senior Full Stack Engineer | Experimentation - Product Analytics | Germany | Remote
description:
Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X . 

We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

This is a remote opportunity and we would be interested in applications from the UK, Ireland, Sweden, Spain and Germany. 

The opportunity: 

Grafana Labs is building a native experimentation platform: a Grafana app that lets teams define A/B tests, connect them to feature flags and product telemetry, and get trustworthy, statistically sound answers about what their changes actually did.

It started as a hackathon project and is now used by Grafana engineering and product teams in our internal environment to run real experiments. The next step is to make it a first-class product: one we rely on every day internally and, over time, one we offer to Grafana Cloud customers alongside Frontend Observability, Session Replay and our other user-experience capabilities.

You'll join the Product Analytics team , a group of highly technical product analysts who help teams across Grafana understand how our products are used and run experiments on them. As the team's dedicated software engineer, you'll own the engineering of the experimentation app and have a lot of influence over where it goes. You'll partner closely with data scientists on the statistics, data engineers on event pipelines and the data warehouse, software engineers across Grafana on feature flags, Frontend Observability and the App Platform, and product stakeholders who rely on experiment results to make decisions. This is a hands-on engineering role that ships production code. It is not an analyst role.

About the product: 

The experimentation app is built on the Grafana App Platform:

- Frontend: a TypeScript and React app plugin using @grafana/ui, plus a custom datasource plugin that powers experiment statistics panels.

- Backend: Go, built with the Grafana App SDK. Experiments are Kubernetes-style custom resources defined in CUE, with an operator, admission webhooks, and support for declarative, GitOps-style management.

- Feature flags: integration with OpenFeature and the OpenFeature Remote Evaluation Protocol (OFREP) , Grafana's multi-tenant feature toggle service, and an embedded GO Feature Flag evaluator.

- Statistics engine: a Bayesian analysis engine (TypeScript, with a Go port) that produces a direction-aware verdict per metric, probability to be best, credible intervals, expected loss and sample-size recommendations.

- Data: experiment exposure and outcome events flow from product instrumentation through RudderStack into BigQuery, or from Grafana Faro into Loki, and are queried live through Grafana datasources.

- AI: experiment authoring assisted by Grafana Assistant , which discovers relevant data and drafts the experiment configuration for a human to review.

What You’ll be doing: 

- Evolve the experimentation app from internal tool to product. Full ownership of features end to end across the React frontend and Go backend, from problem framing and design through rollout, measurement and iteration.

- Build the experimentation experience. Develop intuitive workflows for defining hypotheses, configuring experiments and metrics, managing their lifecycle, and exploring results. Make these experiences useful for product managers and analysts as well as engineers.

- Make instrumentation easier to adopt and trust . Evolve the experimentation SDK and its OpenFeature and Faro integrations. Help teams connect variant assignment, actual exposure, and outcome events with consistent identity and event contracts.

- Connect experiments to the rest of Grafana’s user-experience stack. Integrate with Grafana Faro and Frontend Observability so flag exposures and outcomes are captured automatically, and link experiment results to Session Replay and critical user journeys so teams can see why a variant won, not only that it won.

- Harden the statistics and analysis path. Work with our data analysts to extend the statistics engine, and make analysis scalable, cost-aware and correct. Examples include moving computation server-side, scheduled analysis, alerting on experiment health, and guardrails against misleading results.

- Use AI where it genuinely helps. Extend the Grafana Assistant integration for authoring, explaining and reporting on experiments.

- Raise the engineering bar. Mentor teammates, including analysts who contribute code, through code review, pairing and design docs. Write the architecture decision records (ADRs), docs and demos that help other teams adopt experimentation.

- Own what you ship. Take part in on-call for the services you build, and support the internal teams that run experiments on them.

We invest heavily in developer productivity. You can use modern AI coding assistants as part of your daily workflow (your choice of tools, within security guidelines), backed by a company-funded usage budget so you can iterate quickly without unnecessary friction. We encourage pragmatic AI-assisted development: faster prototyping, test generation, refactors, documentation, and incident follow-ups, always with strong code review and quality standards. You’ll also have access to the latest frontier models from OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google.

What makes you a great fit: 

We highly value people who are intellectually curious, default to transparency, have a strong bias towards action, and are kind and enjoy working as a team.

- Strong full-stack engineering experience. You’ve built and operated production web applications with TypeScript and React, and backend services in Go (or a similar language, with willingness to work in Go). You value maintainability, automated testing and secure development practices.

- Experience building an in-house platform or integrating existing experimentation and A/B testing platform (for example Statsig, Eppo, GrowthBook, Optimizely, LaunchDarkly experiments, or an in-house platform).

- Product and data intuition. You care whether what you shipped actually moved the needle, and you’re comfortable working with event data, SQL and data warehouses such as BigQuery.

- Technical ownership. You’ve delivered complex projects with minimal supervision, broken them into short feedback loops (analyze, design, ship an MVP, learn, iterate), and helped teammates work more effectively.

- Operational responsibility. You’ve been on call, supported software in production, and know how to make systems observable and debuggable.

- Pragmatic AI usage. You use AI coding tools thoughtfully, validate their output, and share practices that improve the team’s speed and quality.

- Clear communication. You can explain technical and statistical tradeoffs to engineers, analysts and product managers in a fully remote, asynchronous environment.

Bonus Points For: 

- Hands-on experience with feature flags and OpenFeature.

- A working understanding of experiment statistics: Bayesian or frequentist testing, sample sizing, variance reduction, and common pitfalls such as peeking and sample ratio mismatch.

- Experience with Kubernetes concepts: custom resources, operators, admission webhooks, GitOps.

- Experience building Grafana plugins or apps, or with the Grafana App SDK or Scenes.

- Familiarity with frontend observability and product analytics tooling, such as Grafana Faro, RUM, session replay, RudderStack or Segment.

- Open source contribution or maintainership.

- Experience as a user of Grafana, Prometheus, Loki or Tempo, whether at work or on a homelab.

Compensation & Rewards: 

In Germany, the base compensation range for this role is €100,000 - €125,000. Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed throughout the interview process. All of our roles include Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), giving every team member ownership in Grafana Labs' success. We believe in shared outcomes—RSUs help us stay aligned and invested as we scale globally.

title: AI Engineer / Consultant
description:
Description 

AI brings huge potential, but many companies are still struggling to release the desired impact. We are a pragmatic and dynamic team to help “empower our business clients with AI”. You, as a talent, are needed to grow our business which started up from three founders with proven track-records in AI consulting and scaled AI implementations. 

For our powerful team, we are looking for a Swiss based AI Engineer / Consultant to develop and deliver innovative AI solutions for our customers in the German- and French-speaking regions of Switzerland.

Your mission 

- Design, implement, and deploy pragmatic AI solutions using state-of-the-art technologies, tailored to client needs and habits, to solve pressing business problems

- Leverage AI solutions and client data to drive real-world impact and address critical business challenges

- Work in high-performing, agile teams and play an active role throughout the project life cycle - from contributing to project proposals to designing and deploying solutions, as well as supporting business development activities

- Build strong relationships with stakeholders across clients, partners and internal teams

- Contribute to Artifact’s growth by developing assets and driving initiatives that support the company’s success

What you can expect 

- Work on real-world projects with Swiss clients, using the latest AI technologies and software

- Get started right away by working on client projects starting your first months at Artifact

- As an AI Engineer / Consultant, you will play a key role in technical consulting and implementation, particularly on external client projects. You’ll also have the opportunity to lead a project within your first year at Artifact, to grow your technical and leadership skills

- Be involved in shaping our internal asset and strategy - your ideas and technical skills will help move Artifact forward

- Enjoy a flexible work environment where you can grow, learn, and be part of a team that is passionate about AI

About Artifact 

Artifact is dedicated to empowering people with AI for the better. As a professional service provider, we do AI and Data Science. Together, we are leveraging the best ideas to find pragmatic and sophisticated solutions with the best suited technology. We help our business clients from any sectors and any size, to accelerate their journey with AI and deliver real impact. 

Your profile 

- Experience in (Gen)AI and Data Science work with a deep understanding of Machine Learning concepts, including Deep Learning, Natural Language Processing and Computer Vision

- Fluency in Python, along with experience in Git, SQL, DevOps and MLOps

- Familiarity with analytics libraries, visualization tools and Big Data frameworks, e.g. NumPy, SciPy, Pandas, scikit-learn, PyTorch, TensorFlow, Spark

- First experience in designing and scaling (Gen)AI solutions in production on cloud platforms (e.g. Azure, AWS or GCP), with exposure to Docker, APIs, backend/frontend development, and microservices architectures

- Excellent written and oral communication (English and German or French is a must )

- Enjoying communication and building relationships with clients and teams is a plus

- Willingness to travel in Switzerland and available work permit in Switzerland

- You intend to start your new job at Artifact within the next 3 months from your point of application

Additional preferred qualification: 

- Experience in consulting

- Experience in frontend engineering e.g. React

- Experience as a full stack engineer is a plus

You’re the ideal candidate if you’re: 

- Ready to move out of your comfort zone

- Willing to keep learning, and to stay up to date in the fast-moving field of AI

- Open-minded and eager to learn with people with different expertise

title: LLM Engineer — Post-Training (Remote - France)
description:
Our Vision & Products

🚀 EverAI — Building the Future of AI Companionship 

One of the Top Largest & Fastest-Growing AI Companies in the World 

60 Million Users in 3 years — Help Us Reach 100M first, 500M next 

At EverAI , we’re shaping what it means to connect with AI. With 60 million users and counting , we're not just building products — we're creating entirely new categories.

Our flagship product is the world’s largest AI companionship platform , redefining relationships for millions. It is governed by our proprietary moderation system, EverGuard — an internal AI designed to ensure everything we build is safe, ethical, and human-first .

And we’re only just getting started! 

Our Team

We are an enthusiastic, passionate and hardworking team of ≈ 100 people. Our founding team has strong entrepreneurial experience building and scaling web products from 0 to IPO.

Alexis Soulopoulos [CEO]

• 10+ years in Tech Executive Leadership 

• Co-Founder Mad Paws Holdings (from 0 to IPO) 

• Forbes 30 under 30 + Deloitte TechFast50 ’22 & ‘23 

Michael Monin [Co-founder & CTO]

• 10+ years as CTO / COO (web2/web3), 3 years in AI/LLM 

• Serial-entrepreneur: MTK Digital (exited / 0->$20m revenue) and Zipchat (AI Chatbot for E-commerce brands) 

Thomas Lacroix [Co-founder & CMO]

• 8+ years in Customer Acquisition & E-commerce Growth 

• Serial-entrepreneur: Curatible (sold to Blackstone) and MTK Digital (exited / 0->$20m revenue) 

Maruša Fasano [CFO/Legal]

• 25+ years in Finance, Strategy, M&A 

• Ex-CFO/M&A @Curatible (exited to Blackstone) 

• Ex-President of the Board @SotremoSA (exited) 

• Co-founder/CFO @SoftOne (exited) 

Your Role

Most LLM roles stop at experimentation.

Here, the models you improve power experiences for 50M+ users. 

Most of our traffic runs on self-hosted, fine-tuned open-weight models . On our internal roleplay evals, our smaller fine-tuned models can outperform much larger off-the-shelf models. Your job is to make them better. 

You’ll join a small AI team led by Marco, our LLM Tech Lead , working closely with our CTO, Product, Web and DevOps teams. You’ll work across data, post-training, evals, and model behavior, taking ideas from failure analysis to production.

The problems are real: personalization, character consistency, long conversations, better evals, multilingual behavior, and faster training cycles. 

If you want to shape model behavior at consumer scale, this is the role. 

Key Responsibilities

- Fine-tune open-weight LLMs using SFT, LoRA/QLoRA and post-training methods such as DPO and GRPO

- Diagnose model failures and turn them into experiments. Decide whether the answer is better data, post-training, prompting or classifiers

- Build training data and evals that directly shape what gets trained next

- Improve model behavior across personalization, consistency, tone, multilingual and group interactions

- Ship to production and use real user behavior to guide the next iteration

- Speed up the training loop so experiments are faster, easier to compare, and more reproducible

Your Qualifications

- You’ve personally post-trained open-weight LLMs for a user-facing product and shipped them to production

- You’ve worked where AI was core to the product or business , not an experimental side feature

- Fine-tuning is core to your experience

- Strong Python, PyTorch and Hugging Face , with hands-on GPU training and debugging

- You build data and evals yourself and make decisions from evidence

- You can take work beyond notebooks into production 

- You use AI tools daily in your own engineering work

- You are fully comfortable working with uncensored models and explicit NSFW content , including harmful material when developing and evaluating moderation system

Bonus points

- Experience with conversational AI, roleplay products, or highly personalized consumer AI

- Multilingual LLMs

- Moderation, safety, or adversarial testing

- Multimodal models

- Open-source LLM / post-training contributions

Why EverAI?

📈 Exponential Growth : From 60M users in 3 years, to 100M next — and 500M beyond

🚀 Track Record of Category-Creating Innovation : We consistently launch world-first AI applications — setting the pace, not following it

🌍 Global Impact : Top-tier user growth, real-world adoption, and cultural relevance

🧠 Proven Leadership : A senior team that’s launched, scaled, and exited & IPO’d multiple scale ups — now fully focused on reshaping AI companionship

👥 Elite Remote Team : 100% remote and built to win — world-class talent from Tier 1 tech companies , with a culture of ownership, velocity, and radical creativity

🛡️ Ethical Core : Our AI ecosystem is governed by EverGuard, our proprietary AI moderation technology , ensuring responsible development at scale

What We Offer

✍️ Contract Type: We prefer B2B, but we’re flexible, what matters is long-term commitment and impact
📍 Work From Anywhere: Fully remote. Choose the environment where you do your best work
🏝️ Paid Time Off: 20 working days of PTO per year to recharge and reset
👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Annual Gathering: A yearly in-person meetup to connect, brainstorm, and celebrate wins together
❤️‍🩹 Health & Wellness Support: Monthly allowance of 100 USD for health insurance expenses & access to unlimited 1:1 sessions with psychologists and lifestyle experts through OpenUp (also available to up to three of your family members)
🏢 Co-Working Space Budget: Work from a co-working space up to twice per month (35 EUR / 40 USD per visit) to stay inspired and connected
📚 Learning Budget: Dedicated funds to support your professional growth: courses, books, conferences, events, or certifications
💻 Company Laptop & Equipment: Laptop provided + monitor budget up to 250 USD + keyboard/mouse/mic/headphones budget up to 150 USD
⚡ AI Tools Access: Premium access to ChatGPT, Hugging Face, Claude Code, and any other tool needed to excel at your job, power your ideas and workflows

🎯 Top Tier Talent Is Our Multiplier

We’re a fully remote group of A-players from Tier 1 tech , led by an exec team who’ve launched, scaled, and exited multiple companies . We move fast, and care deeply about what we build — and who we build it with.

We’re looking for exceptional talent ready to ship & distribute world-first AI products at scale, fast, and co-create with us this category-defining business.

If that’s you — reach out and apply! 

To learn how we collect and use your personal data during the recruitment process, please read our Applicant Privacy Notice . 

Compensation: €75K – €125K

- • Annual Compensation Range (Gross) €75K – €125K

title: Revenue Operations Analyst (m/w/d)
description:
Über Cosuno 

Cosuno digitalisiert die Beschaffung in der Baubranche, einer der größten und zugleich am wenigsten digitalisierten Branchen weltweit. Als Berliner Startup unterstützen wir Bauunternehmen dabei, ihre Beschaffungsprozesse effizienter zu gestalten. Unser Team ist ambitioniert und verfolgt ein gemeinsames Ziel: die digitale Transformation der Baubranche voranzutreiben.

Deine Rolle 

Als Revenue Operations Analyst entwickelst du dich Schritt für Schritt zum Architekten unseres Go-to-Market-Setups. Du arbeitest direkt mit dem Leadership Team zusammen und trägst maßgeblich dazu bei, unsere kommerzielle Effizienz weiter zu steigern. Dabei verwaltest du Prozesse nicht nur, sondern optimierst sie gezielt mithilfe moderner KI-Technologien und datengetriebener Analysen. 

- Prozessoptimierung & Skalierung: Du analysierst unsere Sales-Prozesse End-to-End, identifizierst Engpässe und automatisierst Workflows.

- Reporting & Forecasting: Du verantwortest Teile unseres Reportings und Forecastings und lieferst datenbasierte Insights für die Entscheidungen des Leadership Teams.

- KI-Automatisierung: Du evaluierst neue KI-Tools und überführst manuelle Prozesse in automatisierte, intelligente Abläufe.

- Full Project Ownership: Du verantwortest eigene Projekte von der Konzeption bis zum Go-live und arbeitest dabei eng mit Sales, Customer Success und Finance zusammen.

- Tool-Stack: Du arbeitest mit Salesforce, Salesloft, Avoma, Chargebee und BigQuery.

Projektbeispiele 

Beispiele für Projekte, die unser RevOps-Team zuletzt umgesetzt hat:

- Automatisierung der Kundendatenpflege: Konzeption, Umsetzung und unternehmensweite Einführung einer KI-gestützten Lösung, die Kontaktdaten aus eingehender E-Mail-Korrespondenz automatisch erfasst und im CRM-System aktualisiert, einschließlich Erfolgsmessung und laufender Überwachung

- KI-gestütztes Forderungsmanagement: Auswahl, Aufbau und Optimierung eines KI-Telefonassistenten für automatisierte Zahlungserinnerungen sowie Wirtschaftlichkeitsanalyse im Vergleich zur manuellen Bearbeitung

- Automatisierung von Recruiting-Prozessen: Erstellung standardisierter Kommunikationsvorlagen für Bewerbungsprozesse und Mitarbeit an einem einheitlichen Bewertungssystem für Vorstellungsgespräche

- Vertriebsreporting: Pflege und Weiterentwicklung von Reports und Kennzahlenübersichten für Vertrieb und Management sowie Erstellung eines Leitfadens für neue Mitarbeitende

Dein Profil 

- Erfahrung: Du hast dein Studium erfolgreich abgeschlossen und erste Praxiserfahrung gesammelt, idealerweise in einem Startup, SaaS-Unternehmen oder in der Beratung.

- KI-Affinität: Du bist Early Adopter neuer KI-Tools und setzt sie souverän im Arbeitsalltag ein.

- Analytische Denkweise: Du übersetzt Daten in klare Handlungsempfehlungen und hinterfragst Zahlen kritisch.

- Lösungsorientierung: Du gehst Herausforderungen eigenständig und strukturiert an.

- Excel-Kenntnisse: Du verfügst über sehr gute Kenntnisse in Excel oder Google Sheets.

- Growth Mindset: Du möchtest dich in einem schnell wachsenden Unternehmen weiterentwickeln und langfristig Verantwortung übernehmen.

- Sprachkenntnisse: Du sprichst fließend Deutsch und Englisch.

- Wünschenswert: Erfahrung mit einem CRM-System (idealerweise Salesforce), SQL oder Python.

Warum Cosuno? 

- Gestalte die Go-to-Market-Engine eines wachsenden B2B-SaaS-Unternehmens mit

- Arbeite in einem aufgeschlossenen, kooperativen, dynamischen und internationalen Team

- Du hast die Möglichkeit, in unserem neuen und modernen Office in Berlin-Kreuzberg oder auch komplett im Homeoffice (innerhalb Deutschlands) zu arbeiten

- Firmenevents und regelmäßige Teamevents (offline und online)

- Unbefristeter Vertrag und modernes Equipment

- Offene Feedback-Kultur mit regelmäßigen 1:1-Meetings und Entwicklungsgesprächen

title: Senior Software Engineer, Backend - Platform Team
description:
Cresta unlocks the true potential of the customer experience, turning every conversation into a competitive advantage. Cresta’s unified AI platform combines conversational AI agents, real-time human agent augmentation, and comprehensive conversation intelligence to drive revenue and efficiency gains across every channel. The world’s leading companies, including United Airlines, Cox Communications, and Marriott, use Cresta to power world-class customer experiences every day. 


Born from the Stanford AI Lab, Cresta has raised more than $270 million from the world’s leading investors, including a16z, Greylock, and Sequoia. Cresta’s leadership includes some of the leading minds in AI today. Our CEO, Ping Wu , founded and led Google's Contact Center AI and Vertex AI platforms before joining Cresta to build the future of AI-driven customer experiences.


Over the next few years, AI is going to redefine how people all over the world interact with businesses every day. Come build that future at Cresta.

About the role: 

Cresta’s Core Platform underpins the company’s entire product portfolio. Our long term vision is to build a robust, reliable, secure, and extensible foundation that supports continued innovation, satisfies enterprise customer requirements, and keeps operational costs in check. Two critical components for that are agent assist backend services and scalable authentication systems, tools, processes and frameworks based on industry standards and security best practices. 

This role is focused on building various backend systems needed to enable successful customer integrations:


- Enable agent assist integration for chat and email. This involves working with the frontend platform team, ML teams, infra team and other backend services.

- Expand our backend agent assist services to meet customer requirements and feature requests.

- Address any customer issues that block integrations, affect user experience or system performance.

- Work with the auth and security team to meet Cresta’s diverse authentication and security needs for internal workflows and external customer facing integrations.

We are looking for strong versatile backend engineers who want to work at the intersection of distributed systems, real-time communication, enterprise integrations, and IAM systems.

Why This Role Is Unique: 


- Enterprise-Grade Integrations : Design robust integrations with major CCaaS platforms and customer systems.

- Specialized Auth Experience : Join the Cresta auth team and help build specialized authentication systems to authenticate users, service accounts, virtual agents, server workloads, cloud based authentication for external integrations, etc.

- Agent Assist Integrations : Work directly with the frontend platform team to build solutions for agent assist integrations for various channels such as chat and email and help rollout these integrations in customer environments.

If you’re a strong backend engineer who wants to apply your expertise to real-world AI systems operating inside complex enterprise ecosystems, and expand your expertise in auth, this role offers that opportunity.

Responsibilities :


- Contribute to building the best-in-class company in addition to building the best-in-class product.

- Architect systems that manage real-time conversation state, context propagation, and session lifecycle.

- Play a substantial role in the agent assist integration process (chat and email) and authentication engineering team.

- Work with Cresta product and engineering teams, build and continuously improve the Cresta platform and new product requirements.

- Stay closely with customers and their requirements, analyze the technical tradeoffs, own the customer facing deliverables.

- Demonstrate the engineering best practices in deliverables and daily work. Uphold others to the same high standards.

- Technical ownership in a substantial part of the Cresta authentication stack.

- Ensure high availability, low latency, and strong observability for real-time conversation systems.

- Implement authentication, authorization, compliance, and enterprise security best practices across integrations.

- Drive improvements in reliability, performance, and scalability in production environments handling high interaction volumes

Qualifications We Value: 


- Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or related field.

- 5+ years of experience building scalable backend systems in production environments.

- Strong experience designing and maintaining robust APIs (REST, gRPC).

- Solid understanding of distributed systems and real-time communication architectures.

- Experience integrating with third-party enterprise platforms and APIs.

- Experience working with CCaaS platforms or contact center systems is a strong plus.

- Familiarity with AI Agents, Virtual Agents, or LLM-based systems is a plus.

- Experience with containerized environments (Kubernetes, Docker).

- Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, GCP, or Azure.

- Strong understanding of system reliability, observability, and security in enterprise environments.

- Experience in building authentication systems is a plus.

Perks & Benefits: 


- We offer Cresta employees a variety of medical, dental, and vision plans, designed to fit you and your family’s needs

- Paid parental leave to support you and your family

- Monthly Health & Wellness allowance

- Work from home office stipend to help you succeed in a remote environment

- Lunch reimbursement for in-office employees 

- PTO: 3 weeks in Canada 

Compensation for this position includes a base salary, equity, and a variety of benefits. Actual base salaries will be based on candidate-specific factors, including experience, skillset, and location, and local minimum pay requirements as applicable. We are actively hiring for this role in the US and Canada. Your recruiter can provide further details.

This posting will be used to fill a newly-created role.

We have noticed a rise in recruiting impersonations across the industry, where scammers attempt to access candidates' personal and financial information through fake interviews and offers. All Cresta recruiting email communications will always come from the @cresta.ai domain. Any outreach claiming to be from Cresta via other sources should be ignored. If you are uncertain whether you have been contacted by an official Cresta employee, reach out to recruiting@cresta.ai

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
We’re Capital on Tap 👋
💳 Capital on Tap started because small businesses were underserved. Big banks were slow, their products weren't fit for purpose, and small business owners often couldn't access what they needed. We set out to fix that.

Today we're a financial platform - not just a credit card company. We offer a best-in-class business credit card, SME-focused spend management platform, a savings product that hit £1 billion in funds within its first year, and a growing suite of tools and financial products that make running a small business easier. 

1,000+ employees, £20bn in annual card spend, 200,000+ customers, 17,000+ Trustpilot reviews averaging 4.7 stars, and we're profitable. We’ve done a pretty good job so far, but we’re just getting started! 

We opened our first Portuguese office in Porto in autumn 2025, and in less than a year it has grown to a team of 50. Lisbon is the next step. We're opening our first office in the city and looking for engineers to join as founding members of the team, helping shape how we build, hire and work here from day one.

🏡🏢 The role starts out fully remote. Once our Lisbon office is open, it will move to a hybrid set-up of two days a week on site.

Salary: €55,000-70,000

This is a multiple-headcount role, so please don't be put off if you've seen it advertised for a while.

What You’ll Be Doing 
We’re looking for Senior Full stack Engineers to help us build the best credit card and payment products for small businesses. If you’re looking for an environment where you’re given the freedom to make empowered decisions, research new technologies, and learn/share knowledge with your peers. Then keep on reading!

- You’ll build robust and scalable solutions using .Net technology

- From the first line of code to production, monitoring, and continuous improvement - you’ll own the SDLC

- You’ll craft slick, responsive user interfaces with modern JavaScript frameworks (React), making sure our products don’t just work, they feel great to use

- Teamwork makes the dream work - you’ll partner with Product Managers, QA’s, and fellow Software Engineers

- You’ll build bulletproof unit and integration tests to keep our software sharp and our users happy

- Bugs happen. When they do, you’ll be ready to troubleshoot and tweak as needed

- You’ll bridge the gap between tech speak and business goals, ensuring everyone’s on the same page and moving forward together

We’re Looking For 🔎 
Required skills:

- A minimum of 5+ years hands-on experience in C#, .Net Core, SQL Server, ideally JavaScript and React also!

- Good testing practices, in both Unit and Integration testing

- Good understanding of database technologies

- Experience in using Agile development practices

- A passion for learning new skills and technologies

- A proactive, supportive, and collaborative team player

Our Tech Stack 

- Backend: C#, .Net, .Net Core

- Frontend: React, JavaScript

- Mobile: Flutter, Dart

- Databases: SQL Server, MongoDB

- Cloud: Azure & GCP

Interview Process 🤝 

- First stage: 30-minute intro, CV review, and values with a Talent Partner

- Second stage: 45-minute “Tech Chat” with a Team Manager

- Final stage: 90-minute Code Pairing + 30-minute Values Interview

Diversity & Inclusion 🌈 
We welcome, consider and encourage applications from anyone who shares our commitment to inclusivity. Join us in creating a space where authenticity thrives, and everyone can do their best work.

Great Work Deserves Great Perks 

Check out our benefits:

🏥 Private Healthcare through AdvanceCare
🎁 Anniversary Rewards (€280, €570, €860, 4-week fully paid sabbatical)

🏖️ 36 days holiday (inclusive of public holidays with public holidays carried over if they fall on a weekend)
📖 Annual Learning and Wellbeing Budget
💬 6 free therapy sessions per year
🍫 Free drinks and snacks in our offices

Other Info
👍Check out our ‘Top Tips’ for interviewing. 
✔️Keep updated on new job opportunities by following us on Linkedin .
📧Email careers@capitalontap.com if you have any questions.

Excited to work here? Apply!
If you’d like to progress your career within our fast growing, profitable fintech then click apply and we will aim to get back to you within 3 working days (during busy periods this could take up to 5 working days.)

title: Senior Cloud Engineer
description:
At Luscii, we're creating space for care by developing and improving digital healthcare applications that make a real difference in people's lives through several applications. From Luscii Thuismeten, which helps healthcare professionals monitor patients remotely, to OMRON Connect, connecting millions of people with their health data through OMRON devices, and other applications that expand the possibilities of digital healthcare.

Together with healthcare professionals and partners around the world, we're working towards a future where people receive the right care in the right place. As our Senior Cloud Engineer, you'll help shape and modernise the cloud infrastructure behind these applications, building a reliable, scalable and future-proof foundation for millions of users worldwide.

Our applications have different histories, architectures and technical challenges. OMRON Connect, for example, runs on an AWS backend serving several million monthly active users. Parts of its infrastructure still carry legacy, including manual processes, scattered knowledge, inconsistent observability and release processes that make changes slower and riskier than they should be.

We're working towards a more consistent engineering foundation across our applications. Think Infrastructure as Code, cloud-native and event-driven architecture where it adds value, safe continuous deployment and observability by default. We're bringing more senior engineering expertise in-house to turn that ambition into concrete technical decisions, shared standards and a roadmap our teams can own. And that's where you come in 😉

Your role

You will work across our engineering teams, helping shape the cloud infrastructure behind our digital healthcare applications. Your focus will be on making the right architectural decisions, modernising existing platforms and enabling teams to independently build, maintain and improve their systems.

This isn't a greenfield architecture exercise. You will be improving live healthcare platforms while balancing technical improvements with product delivery, security, regulatory requirements and the realities of working with stakeholders across different countries, including the Netherlands and Japan.

What you will be doing, among others:

- Own and evolve the Cloud & Backend roadmap, translating the engineering vision into clear priorities, trade-offs and next steps.

- Drive cross-team architecture decisions to a close, making sure decisions are transparent, documented and followed through.

- Establish shared technical standards and guardrails that allow teams to work autonomously without creating unnecessary dependencies.

- Work hands-on with engineers on AWS and Terraform, reviewing designs and pull requests and challenging technical choices where needed.

- Coach and pair with engineers, helping knowledge spread across teams and supporting the growth of seniority and ownership.

- Work with product owners, QA, engineering leadership and colleagues in Japan to balance technical direction with product, regulatory, security and cost considerations.

- Help move the platform towards automated infrastructure, safer deployments and stronger observability without relying on a big-bang rewrite.

The responsibilities outlined above reflect how we currently envision this role. As we continue to grow and evolve, the scope and focus of the position may naturally change, influenced by your own ideas and insights. The way we work is built around the belief that everyone's input matters. If you see opportunities to improve the way we do things, or believe a process could be designed differently to achieve a better outcome, we encourage you to bring those ideas forward. Discuss them with your teammates, challenge the status quo, and help shape how we move forward together.

Why Luscii?

Read more about working at Luscii / OMRON and how we work as a team. Together, we are working on a mission to create space for care. Freedom, autonomy and ownership are of great importance in this. You are responsible for your own results and work according to the principles of Holacracy. Luscii is part of OMRON DH ; together we built for the long term. To work on making healthcare better.

Most important benefits

- Salary : An annual maximum remuneration of approximately € 85.000 gross per year is estimated for this position (based on 32 hours per week – that’s full-time at Luscii), depending on the interviews, your experience, background and knowledge.

- Remote-first : Work from anywhere in The Netherlands. We stay connected through monthly in-person team days called Assemblii .

- Flexible setup : Create your own ideal workspace. Whatever works best for you - we’ve got you covered here. We do work from Mondays to Thursdays, as 32 hours per week is fulltime.

The ideal candidate…

… probably doesn't exist, but if you can tick most of the checkboxes below, please apply! We are looking for someone who enjoys taking ownership of complex technical challenges, makes pragmatic engineering decisions, and is excited about helping others succeed along the way.

You know when to step up, when to involve colleagues and when to move forward decisively. Working independently does not mean working in isolation for you. You feel at ease being both a self-starter and a committed team player, contributing to shared goals while taking responsibility for your own domain. You value open communication, transparency, and mutual trust.

- You have at least 5+ years of experience in cloud/backend engineering and multiple years of hands-on experience with AWS and Terraform (Infrastructure as Code). 

- You are comfortable reviewing designs and pull requests. Experience with serverless and event-driven architectures is very valuable. All combined with experience in serverless AWS, Node.js/TypeScript tech stacks.

- You actively coach, pair, review and share knowledge, with a focus on building ownership and seniority across the teams around you.

- You understand what matters: the importance of making pragmatic technical choices within clear security, compliance and regulatory boundaries.

- You are open to working in a Holacratic organization and curious about our way of organizing work, roles, and responsibilities;

- English is our primary language for all internal communication at Luscii, so you're fluent in that language.

Interested? Apply now! 

Would you like more information? Feel free to contact our recruiter Björn Bogerd via 

What does the recruitment process look like? 

We organise three interviews for each vacancy. It is an extensive process, but we want to ensure that there is a good fit in regards to a potential collaboration, our culture and our way of working. All interviews are conducted online and the entire procedure is planned in advance to keep momentum.

title: Talent Pool: Data Engineer (m/f/d)
description:
About RoomPriceGenie ✨🧞‍♂️

Founded in 2017, RoomPriceGenie is dedicated to helping hoteliers around the globe achieve optimal pricing. 🌍 We understand that many small hotels face challenges with digitalization, making their operations increasingly complex and often resulting in lost revenue. This is where we come in!

We have developed a powerful solution that enables hotels to set the right prices in just seconds. ⏱️ Our state-of-the-art algorithm analyzes both internal hotel data and market trends to recommend pricing strategies that enhance revenue and improve booking rates. 

With customers spanning the globe—from the USA and Canada to Iceland, South Africa, China, Slovenia, Italy, and the UK—RoomPriceGenie has made a meaningful impact in the hospitality industry, and our clients love the results. ❤️

Now, we are excited to expand our customer base and spread the word about how we can support hoteliers in optimizing their pricing strategies. We invite you to join us on this journey! We actively encourage applications from candidates with diverse backgrounds to enrich our team and drive innovation. 

Do you care as much about why we build something as how we build it? At RoomPriceGenie, Data Engineers work where software engineering, data analytics and business impact meet. You won’t just build pipelines: you’ll understand who relies on your work and which decisions it enables. Our data powers pricing recommendations for 3,000+ hotels worldwide on a modern data stack (Snowflake, Databricks, Dagster, dbt, AWS), helping independent hoteliers set the right prices. When you ship something here, you see the direct impact on real businesses and the people who run them.

We take both culture and product seriously, and we’ve been recognised for both: Best Place to Work in Hotel Tech (2026) and Best Revenue Management Software (2026). Our engineers get real ownership and autonomy, with support whenever they need it.

We regularly hire Data Engineers, fully remote , especially in these locations:

- Germany (DACH)

- Spain

- Portugal

- UK & Ireland

- Netherlands

This is our talent pool for Data Engineer roles. There may not be an open position right now, but by applying here you’ll be the first to hear from us when a role opens up in your location.

Your Role 

- Build and own: Design scalable data pipelines on our modern stack (Snowflake, Dagster, dbt) and take them from idea to production to monitoring.

- Modernise with purpose: Help migrate legacy Django/Celery pipelines to our modern platform and reshape how data flows through our product.

- Bridge the gap: Work closely with Product, Analytics and Engineering (Backend, Frontend and Data Science), turn business questions into technical designs and make sure analysts and data scientists can actually use what you build.

- Care about quality: Champion data reliability through testing, observability and documentation, because multiple teams depend on your work every day.

Your Profile 

- 4+ years of professional Python experience, ideally in data engineering and/or backend systems

- Strong experience building and maintaining production ETL/ELT pipelines on modern cloud data warehouses (e.g. Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery or Redshift)

- Strong data modelling skills, including analytics-ready schema design, fact/dimension modelling and performance optimisation, plus solid data testing and documentation practices

- Experience with orchestrated data pipelines (e.g. Dagster, Airflow or similar)

- Experience building backend or ingestion services with Python web frameworks such as Django, FastAPI or Flask

- Familiarity with background task processing and asynchronous workflows (e.g. Celery)

- Experience with cloud infrastructure, preferably AWS (e.g. S3, RDS/Aurora)

- Strong understanding of software design principles and data pipeline architecture

- Experience working with large datasets using pandas, polars or NumPy

- An analytical mindset with an interest in data quality, KPIs and data-driven decision-making

- Able to explain complex technical topics clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders

- High ownership: you take responsibility for reliability, quality and long-term maintainability

- A collaborative, egoless team player who enjoys working across teams

- Fluent in English and comfortable in technical discussions

- Based in a European time zone (UTC+0 to UTC+2)

Nice to Have 

- Hands-on experience with dbt (modelling, testing, documentation, performance tuning)

- Experience with or interest in modernising legacy data pipelines

- Hands-on experience with Celery & RabbitMQ, PostgreSQL, Django/FastAPI, Datadog and/or Sentry

- Semantic layers or metrics modelling tools (e.g. Cube, Looker/LookML, dbt metrics or MetricFlow)

- Experience building data observability and monitoring solutions

What We Offer at RoomPriceGenie 💪

At RoomPriceGenie, we don’t just offer jobs; we offer an adventure! 🚀 Join us in an exciting startup atmosphere where you can grow your career while changing the world for tens of thousands of independent hoteliers. 🌍 Our global and diverse team is fueled by passion and a shared mission. We thrive in a culture that’s all about transparency, respect, and making a real impact together. 

Here’s what you can expect when you become part of our Genie family:

title: Staff Forward Deployed Engineer, EMEA
description:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

* Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab. 

An overview of this role 

GitLab’s Forward Deployed Engineering team is a field-situated product engineering function focused on strategic customer outcomes, artificial intelligence (AI) adoption, and direct contributions to GitLab’s product. This isn't a traditional field engineering, solutions architecture, or professional services role. As a Staff Forward Deployed Engineer, you'll work closely with customers while maintaining the technical standards and contribution discipline of a Staff-level product engineer.

You'll work where strategic customer urgency, complex technical ambiguity, and GitLab product execution intersect. You'll partner directly with strategic customers and teams across Product, Engineering, Support, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), Solutions Architecture (SA), Customer Success Architecture (CSA), Customer Success Management (CSM), and Professional Services. You'll diagnose and resolve high-impact adoption blockers, contribute production-quality fixes and features, and turn what you learn into repeatable patterns for GitLab and its customers.

Why this role exists 

Strategic customers sometimes encounter challenges that are too broad, deep, urgent, or cross-functional for any single team to own from start to finish. These challenges may involve product gaps, performance degradation, scale bottlenecks, AI governance, adoption blockers, architectural constraints, Git usage patterns, continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) complexity, application programming interface (API) automation, security requirements, or operational instability.

Forward Deployed Engineering provides technical stewardship in these moments. The team doesn't simply observe, report, or escalate. You'll engage directly, diagnose the underlying technical problem, collaborate with the right teams, contribute code or technical solutions where appropriate, and transition the outcome into normal ownership once the customer is stable and the learning can be reused.

What you’ll do 

Product contribution 

- Contribute production-quality code to GitLab’s product and adjacent systems.

- Develop bug fixes, features, integrations, tooling, and performance improvements when strategic customer outcomes require direct engineering work.

- Work within GitLab’s product and engineering processes, including issue discovery, merge request creation, testing, review, documentation, and maintainability.

- Partner with Product and Engineering so customer-driven solutions support long-term product direction rather than becoming one-off customizations.

- Turn blockers discovered in the field into durable product improvements, reference architectures, documentation, and repeatable implementation patterns.

Strategic technical stewardship 

- Engage with strategically important customers when adoption, retention, executive confidence, or public trust is materially at risk.

- Diagnose complex problems across GitLab product behavior, customer architecture, Git internals, CI/CD workflows, API usage, observability, infrastructure, networking, and cloud environments.

- Coordinate across Product, Engineering, SRE, Support, SA, CSA, CSM, Professional Services, and customer technical teams to drive resolution from discovery through handoff.

- Provide recommendations grounded in data, traces, and systems analysis to improve GitLab usage, workflows, automation, and architecture.

- Create durable outcomes without establishing permanent dependency on Forward Deployed Engineering.

AI adoption and agentic software development lifecycle 

- Drive governed, measurable, and production-oriented adoption of GitLab Duo Agent Platform with strategic customers.

- Identify and resolve AI adoption blockers involving governance, usage controls, auditability, security, compliance, operating models, workflow design, and integrations.

- Develop customer-safe adoption patterns for the agentic software development lifecycle (SDLC), AI-assisted development, intent-based review, AI governance, and human-in-the-loop software delivery.

- Partner with Product, Engineering, Field, and Customer Success teams to turn AI adoption learning into reusable guidance and product improvements.

Thought leadership 

- Create technical narratives grounded in customer experience and product reality that can help shape the industry’s approach.

- Contribute to Well-Architected Frameworks, whitepapers, webinars, reference architectures, technical strategy memos, and adoption frameworks.

- Guide ideas through discovery, formulation, validation, amplification, and adoption across GitLab.

- Partner with SA, CSA, Product, Engineering, Marketing, Product Marketing Management, CSM, Support, and executive stakeholders to make technical thought leadership a shared company capability.

What you’ll bring 

- Staff-level experience building, operating, or improving complex production software systems.

- Experience contributing to large, mature product codebases with high standards for testing, maintainability, performance, and security.

- Strong Ruby on Rails or Go experience and the ability to contribute directly to GitLab’s product and adjacent systems.

- Experience with AI-assisted software development, agentic workflows, AI governance, model evaluation, context management, prompt and workflow design, or AI adoption in enterprise environments.

- Experience diagnosing complex system behavior across application code, data stores, infrastructure, observability, networking, APIs, and customer usage patterns.

- Deep knowledge of modern DevSecOps workflows, including Git, merge requests, CI/CD, security controls, compliance needs, and enterprise software delivery.

title: Cloud Systems Administrator
description:
Headquarters: 

URL: https://oneimaging.com 

Radiology is the second most used healthcare service, used by over 51% of the workforce annually. Despite the critical role of radiology in healthcare, the process for undergoing a medical imaging exam has remained unchanged for decades. OneImaging is solving this with a concierge approach and a premium-quality radiology network of over 5,000 vetted providers across 48 states, which also reduces imaging costs by 60-80%. Our solution helps patients and families access essential radiology services at fair prices and without surprise bills, all while delivering immediate savings and ROI for employers and payers on every exam.

The Systems Administrator owns the day-to-day administration of our SaaS and cloud vendor stack, with security and logging as the first priority. You will manage user access across every platform we use, keep audit logging and security controls configured and reviewed, write scripts to automate repetitive admin work, and act as a first responder on security incidents. You will also provide hands-on IT support to employees. This is a generalist role for someone who likes owning systems end to end: you are the person who knows how each vendor is set up, who has access to what, and where the logs live. 

What you'll do: 

Vendor and SaaS administration (security and logging first) 

- Serve as the primary administrator for our SaaS and cloud platforms: tenant settings, SSO/SAML and SCIM integration, MFA enforcement, API keys, roles and permissions.

- Configure and maintain audit logging on every platform that supports it; centralize logs where possible and make sure retention meets our compliance needs.

- Run periodic access reviews, remove stale accounts and over-privileged roles, and keep an accurate inventory of who has admin rights where.

- Own the security posture of each vendor: review security settings on new tools before rollout, track vendor security notices, and evaluate new vendor requests for risk.

User lifecycle and identity

- Onboard and offboard employees and contractors across all systems the same day, driven from Rippling and Google Workspace, our identity sources of truth.

- Manage groups, roles and licenses; keep license counts right-sized and flag waste.

- Maintain device enrollment, MDM policies and endpoint security for company laptops.

Scripting and automation

- Write and maintain scripts (Python, PowerShell, Bash) and use vendor APIs to automate provisioning, access reviews, log collection and reporting.

- Build lightweight integrations between systems (for example, HRIS to identity provider to SaaS) so manual admin work shrinks over time.

Security incident response

- Act as a first responder on security alerts: triage, contain (disable accounts, revoke tokens, isolate devices), gather evidence from logs, and escalate.

- Participate in post-incident reviews and implement the fixes that come out of them.

- Help maintain and test our incident response and business continuity runbooks.

IT support

- Provide tier 1–2 support to employees: hardware, accounts, access, video conferencing, printers and office network.

- Procure, image and manage laptops and peripherals; keep an asset inventory current.

- Write and keep up internal how-to documentation so common requests become self-service.

Platforms you will administer

These are our largest software and cloud vendors by spend over the last 12 months. Deep experience with the first group is expected; the rest you will pick up on the job.

Area

Platforms

Cloud infrastructure

Amazon Web Services (IAM, CloudTrail, GuardDuty, Security Hub)

Identity, HR and devices

Rippling (HRIS, SSO, device management) and Google Workspace, used together as our identity source of truth

Productivity and email

Google Workspace (admin console, Vault, security center)

Customer support and CRM

Zendesk, Salesforce, Intercom

Communications

Zoom, Aircall, Twilio

Data and engineering

Databricks, MongoDB Atlas, Sentry, Linear, Postman, Stytch

AI platforms

Anthropic, OpenAI (API key and usage management)

Collaboration and design

Notion, Lucid, Figma, Adobe, Scribe

Security tools

NordVPN Teams, Virtru (email encryption)

Healthcare operations

Waystar, AdvancedMD

Marketing and recruiting

Braze, ActiveCampaign, Greenhouse, LinkedIn

About you: 

- 3+ years administering SaaS and cloud platforms in a company of 50–500 people, including Google Workspace and an identity/HR platform like Rippling or Okta, and ideally AWS.

- Hands-on experience configuring SSO/SAML, SCIM provisioning, MFA policies and role-based access.

- Working knowledge of audit logging and log review: you know what a CloudTrail event, a Workspace audit log or a Zendesk audit entry looks like and what to do with it.

- Scripting ability in at least one of Python, PowerShell or Bash, and comfort calling REST APIs.

- Experience responding to security incidents (phishing, compromised accounts, lost devices) and documenting what happened.

- Strong IT support instincts: you communicate clearly with non-technical colleagues and close tickets fast.

- Familiarity with HIPAA or a comparable compliance framework (SOC 2, ISO 27001) and what it means for access control and logging.

Nice to have:

- AWS Certified SysOps Administrator, Security Specialty, or Google Workspace Administrator certification.

- Experience with a SIEM or log aggregation tool (Datadog, Splunk, Google SecOps, or similar) and writing detection rules.

- MDM experience (Rippling, Jamf, Kandji, Intune) and macOS/Windows endpoint hardening.

- Terraform or other infrastructure-as-code for managing AWS and SaaS configuration.

- Prior work in a healthcare or other regulated company.

- Experience administering API usage and keys for AI platforms (Anthropic, OpenAI) and setting spend and access controls.

The base salary range for this position is $60,000 - $75,000. Individual compensation will depend on various factors, including qualifications, skills, experience, location, and applicable laws. In addition to base salary, this role is eligible to participate in our equity incentive and competitive benefits plans.

We're working at the frontier of autonomous systems, building agents that don't just chat, but run entire businesses.
