Over the next 12 months, our focus is on reliability, throughput, and self-improvement, making every launch better than the last.

About the role

We're looking for a hands-on AI Engineer to take ownership of the architecture and development of our autonomous agent system.

You'll lead the technical direction of the platform, building multi-agent orchestration systems, self-improving agent harnesses, and AI-powered backend services. This is a highly technical leadership role that combines architectural decision-making with hands-on engineering.

You'll be expected to ship production code, make key technical decisions, improve agent behavior in production, and help establish the engineering standards as the company scales.

Responsibilities

- Own the system architecture and make key technical decisions across the platform.

- Design and build multi-agent systems and orchestration infrastructure that take products from idea to launch.

- Develop self-improving agent harnesses, including feedback loops, evaluation systems, and memory.

- Build and maintain AI-powered backend services on top of LLM APIs such as Anthropic, OpenAI, and Gemini.

- Write production code, particularly around agent runtime and orchestration.

- Debug and improve AI behavior in production through prompt engineering, structured outputs, retries, and fallbacks.

- Break down complex technical challenges into actionable milestones and prioritize the engineering roadmap.

- Establish engineering standards around code reviews, testing, observability, and release processes.

- Lead and support the engineering team while remaining deeply involved in implementation.

Requirements

- 4+ years of professional software engineering experience.

- Previous technical leadership experience at an early-stage company (Founding Engineer, Tech Lead, Head of Engineering, or similar).

- Hands-on experience building and shipping multi-agent systems and orchestration frameworks to production.

- Experience developing self-improving or self-evolving agent harnesses.

title: Functioneel Applicatie Beheerder Backend Platform
description:
Ervaren Functioneel Applicatiebeheerder 

32–38 uur | Assen | Hybride werken 

Als ervaren Functioneel Applicatiebeheerder zorg jij ervoor dat bedrijfskritische applicaties betrouwbaar functioneren én help je ons om het beheer verder te ontwikkelen. Je krijgt de ruimte om verbeteringen te signaleren, initiatief te nemen en samen met collega's daadwerkelijk veranderingen door te voeren.

Wat ga je doen? 

Als Functioneel Applicatiebeheerder ben jij de verbindende schakel tussen gebruikers, de business, IT-teams en externe leveranciers.

Je werkt met verschillende bedrijfsapplicaties, zoals AFAS, AXON en CODA, en zorgt ervoor dat deze goed aansluiten op de processen en behoeften van onze organisatie.

Je houdt je bezig met het dagelijkse beheer, maar kijkt ook continu naar mogelijkheden om onze applicaties, dienstverlening en beheerprocessen te verbeteren.

Concreet betekent dit dat je: 

- Applicaties betrouwbaar laat functioneren. Je beheert verschillende bedrijfsapplicaties, ondersteunt gebruikers en zorgt ervoor dat incidenten en verstoringen effectief worden opgelost.

- Complexe vraagstukken analyseert. Je onderzoekt waar problemen ontstaan, bijvoorbeeld in een applicatie, koppeling of bedrijfsproces, en schakelt met de juiste specialisten of leveranciers.

- Verbeteringen initieert en realiseert. Je signaleert knelpunten, denkt mee over structurele oplossingen en helpt om applicaties en processen slimmer en efficiënter in te richten.

- Het beheer verder professionaliseert. Je draagt bij aan duidelijke beheerafspraken, goed ingerichte processen, heldere verantwoordelijkheden en goede documentatie.

- Meewerkt aan veranderingen. Je bent betrokken bij wijzigingen, testen, releases, migraties en de ingebruikname van nieuwe of aangepaste functionaliteiten.

- De verbinding legt tussen business en IT. Je begrijpt wat gebruikers nodig hebben en vertaalt hun vragen naar passende oplossingen, in samenwerking met collega's en leveranciers.

Daarbij heb je oog voor onderwerpen als informatiebeveiliging, autorisaties, continuïteit en compliance.

Meer dan dagelijks beheer 

Wat deze functie interessant maakt, is dat je niet alleen verantwoordelijk bent voor het goed functioneren van applicaties, maar ook bijdraagt aan de verdere ontwikkeling van onze beheerorganisatie.

We willen ons functioneel beheer steeds slimmer, duidelijker en professioneler organiseren. Denk aan het verbeteren van werkprocessen, het versterken van samenwerking en het creëren van meer overzicht en eigenaarschap.

Jouw ervaring, ideeën en initiatief zijn daarbij van waarde.

Wat breng je mee? 

Je bent een ervaren Functioneel Applicatiebeheerder die graag begrijpt hoe systemen, processen en mensen met elkaar samenhangen.

Je houdt van structuur, maar weet ook flexibel om te gaan met veranderingen. Wanneer een gebruiker aangeeft dat iets niet werkt, neem jij geen genoegen met een snelle oplossing. Je wilt begrijpen wat er aan de hand is en hoe je kunt voorkomen dat hetzelfde probleem opnieuw ontstaat.

Je communiceert gemakkelijk met verschillende mensen, van eindgebruikers tot technische specialisten en leveranciers.

Verder herken jij jezelf in het volgende: 

- HBO-werk- en -denkniveau hebt richting van IT, bedrijfskunde of informatiemanagement;

- Je begrijpt bedrijfsprocessen en kunt goed analyseren hoe applicaties deze processen ondersteunen.

- Je hebt ervaring met het afhandelen van incidenten, wijzigingen en gebruikersvragen en weet hierin overzicht en structuur aan te brengen.

- Je werkt gemakkelijk samen met verschillende stakeholders en leveranciers en weet mensen met elkaar te verbinden.

- Zorgvuldig omgaat met onderwerpen als autorisaties, documentatie, compliance, continuïteit en beheerafspraken;

- Communicatief sterk bent en complexe onderwerpen begrijpelijk kunt maken voor gebruikers en collega’s;

- Proactief verbeteringen signaleert en eigenaarschap toont.E

Ervaring met ITIL, Agile werken, SLA, P1 processen of onderwerpen zoals autorisatiebeheer en compliance. Hetzelfde geldt voor ervaring met enterprise-applicaties, platformdiensten of identity- en accessmanagement.

Waar kom je terecht? 

Je gaat aan de slag binnen Univé IT Kern , waar verschillende teams samenwerken aan het beheren, ondersteunen en doorontwikkelen van ons IT-landschap. Binnen IT Kern werken we aan applicaties, platformen, infrastructuur, netwerkdiensten en securityoplossingen die essentieel zijn voor onze dagelijkse dienstverlening.

Je maakt deel uit van een omgeving waarin techniek, processen en mensen samenkomen. Je werkt met collega's die graag kennis delen, verantwoordelijkheid nemen en elkaar helpen. Samen zorgen we ervoor dat onze IT-dienstverlening betrouwbaar blijft en tegelijkertijd klaar is voor de toekomst.

Binnen het Backend Platform ligt de nadruk op het beheren en verbeteren van bedrijfsapplicaties en ondersteunende IT-diensten.

Je krijgt te maken met verschillende gebruikers, IT-teams en leveranciers. Dat maakt je werk veelzijdig en vraagt om zowel technische affiniteit als gevoel voor de organisatie.

title: Senior Software Engineer, Backend (AI Agent Integrations)
description:
Cresta unlocks the true potential of the customer experience, turning every conversation into a competitive advantage. Cresta’s unified AI platform combines conversational AI agents, real-time human agent augmentation, and comprehensive conversation intelligence to drive revenue and efficiency gains across every channel. The world’s leading companies, including United Airlines, Cox Communications, and Marriott, use Cresta to power world-class customer experiences every day. 

Born from the Stanford AI Lab, Cresta has raised more than $270 million from the world’s leading investors, including a16z, Greylock, and Sequoia. Cresta’s leadership includes some of the leading minds in AI today. Our CEO, Ping Wu , founded and led Google's Contact Center AI and Vertex AI platforms before joining Cresta to build the future of AI-driven customer experiences.

Over the next few years, AI is going to redefine how people all over the world interact with businesses every day. Come build that future at Cresta.

About the role:

Cresta’s AI Agent team is building enterprise-grade AI Agents that can operate inside real-world contact center environments. A critical part of that mission is enabling our AI Agents to seamlessly integrate with customers’ CCaaS platforms (Contact Center as a Service), including voice and digital channels — and to smoothly transition conversations between AI and human agents when needed.

This role is focused on building the backend systems that allow our AI Agents to:

- Integrate deeply with leading CCaaS platforms

- Participate in live customer conversations across voice and chat

- Maintain full conversation state and context

- Perform real-time actions within the CCaaS ecosystem

- Seamlessly hand off conversations to human agents — without losing context, history, or workflow state

- Support human agents with AI assistance after transfer

We are looking for strong backend engineers who want to work at the intersection of distributed systems, real-time communication, enterprise integrations, and AI Agent orchestration.

This is not a pure research role — it is about building production-grade infrastructure that enables AI Agents to operate reliably in mission-critical customer environments.

Why This Role Is Unique: 

- AI + Real-Time Systems : Work on infrastructure that enables AI Agents to participate in live conversations at scale.

- Enterprise-Grade Integrations : Design robust integrations with major CCaaS platforms and customer systems.

- Human-AI Collaboration : Build the systems that make AI-to-human handoff seamless, contextual, and reliable.

- High-Impact Engineering : Your work directly determines how smoothly AI Agents operate in production environments.

If you’re a strong backend engineer who wants to apply your expertise to real-world AI systems operating inside complex enterprise ecosystems, this role offers that opportunity.

Responsibilities :

- Design and build scalable backend services that integrate Cresta’s AI Agents with customers’ CCaaS platforms.

- Architect systems that manage real-time conversation state, context propagation, and session lifecycle.

- Implement seamless AI-to-human handoff mechanisms, ensuring full context transfer and minimal disruption to the customer experience.

- Develop secure and reliable integrations with CCaaS APIs (voice, chat, messaging, routing, agent desktop, etc.).

- Collaborate closely with ML engineers and AI researchers to operationalize AI Agent capabilities in live environments.

- Ensure high availability, low latency, and strong observability for real-time conversation systems.

- Implement authentication, authorization, compliance, and enterprise security best practices across integrations.

- Drive improvements in reliability, performance, and scalability in production environments handling high interaction volumes

Qualifications We Value: 

- Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or related field.

- 5+ years of experience building scalable backend systems in production environments.

- Strong experience designing and maintaining robust APIs (REST, gRPC).

- Solid understanding of distributed systems and real-time communication architectures.

- Experience integrating with third-party enterprise platforms and APIs.

- Experience working with CCaaS platforms or contact center systems is a strong plus.

- Familiarity with AI Agents, Virtual Agents, or LLM-based systems is a plus.

- Experience with containerized environments (Kubernetes, Docker).

- Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, GCP, or Azure.

- Strong understanding of system reliability, observability, and security in enterprise environments.

Perks & Benefits: 

- We offer Cresta employees a variety of medical, dental, and vision plans, designed to fit you and your family’s needs

- Paid parental leave to support you and your family

- Monthly Health & Wellness allowance

- Work from home office stipend to help you succeed in a remote environment

- Lunch reimbursement for in-office employees 

- PTO: 3 weeks in Canada 

Compensation for this position includes a base salary, equity, and a variety of benefits. Actual base salaries will be based on candidate-specific factors, including experience, skillset, and location, and local minimum pay requirements as applicable. We are actively hiring for this role in the US and Canada. Your recruiter can provide further details.

We have noticed a rise in recruiting impersonations across the industry, where scammers attempt to access candidates' personal and financial information through fake interviews and offers. All Cresta recruiting email communications will always come from the @cresta.ai domain. Any outreach claiming to be from Cresta via other sources should be ignored. If you are uncertain whether you have been contacted by an official Cresta employee, reach out to recruiting@cresta.ai

Every XTM product connects to it, which makes its architecture one of the most structuring technical decisions at Filigran.

Write production code, prototype new approaches before the team adopts them, review critical PRs so that feedback teaches, and unblock engineers.

Key collaborators: XTM One engineering team and its verticals; XTM Foundation (Principal and Staff Engineers across OpenCTI, OpenAEV, OpenGRC); Product leadership; open source contributors.

Working model: embedded in the XTM One team, with regular XTM Foundation work.

🧬 Profile We're Looking For

10+ years in software engineering, with technical leadership on complex production platforms.

- 
Strong fullstack background, with a backend and architecture focus. You master TypeScript and Python , the core languages of XTM One, and you can take a feature from the data model all the way to the UI.

Strong system design : distributed systems, scalability, performance, security, observability.

About Recare

As one of the leading German HealthTech companies, we are reshaping discharge management – technology-driven, patient-centered, and free from bureaucracy. In addition to our market-leading SaaS platform, we develop AI solutions that radically simplify processes in hospitals and for aftercare providers, relieve healthcare professionals, and refocus attention on patients. Today, we already connect two-thirds of all German hospitals with over 650 rehabilitation clinics and 25,000 nursing and homecare providers. With currently around 100 employees, we continue to grow – and we are looking for people with character who want to help us improve the healthcare system and solve administrative complexity across care journeys in Europe.

What to expect as our Software Engineer – Desktop Automation / RPA (m/w/d):

- Purposeful work – your role will have a positive impact on patients, their families, and healthcare professionals.

- Company culture – we believe in flat hierarchies that promote high performance and strong team dynamics. We foster an environment characterized by mutual respect, loyalty, and recognition. Together, we strive for our goals – and expect the same from you.

- Flexibility – want to pick up your child from daycare? Like to exercise during lunch? We'll support you. We are a remote-friendly company offering flexible working hours. Workations are also possible by arrangement.

- Edenred card – which you can use according to your needs.

- Extra vacation day – so you can celebrate your birthday with your loved ones, you'll have the day off.

In this role, you can make an impact and grow with us as Software Engineer – Desktop Automation / RPA (m/w/d):

Hospital staff still spend hours typing the same patient data into different systems. Our in-house RPA tool ends that: it automates hospital information systems (HIS) on Windows desktops so our data lands in patient forms automatically. We don't use UiPath or Blue Prism. We build our own engine in TypeScript, on Electron and Node with native Windows bindings.

You'll join the Interoperability team as a hands-on engineer. Your main focus is the engine itself; everything else builds on it.

- You build, extend and stabilize the core of our RPA engine.

- You make automations reliable in hospital environments we don't fully control, with remote updates and failure monitoring.

- You automate HIS applications on Windows, including the hard legacy cases: UI Automation, Java Access Bridge, SAP GUI Scripting or the browser where the app runs locally.

- You solve the Citrix problem. Most hospitals serve their HIS through Citrix, where all we see is pixels, so you work with OCR, image anchors, mouse and keyboard input, and the redraw, scrolling and display-scaling issues that come with them.

- You help extend the engine with new capabilities such as document extraction and voice input.

- You set up the rollout process with our implementation team: installers, code signing and autostart in locked-down hospital IT, and fixing problems on machines you can't log into.

- You protect health data by applying security best practices and complying with privacy regulations.

Here's how we picture you as our Software Engineer – Desktop Automation / RPA (m/w/d):

- You have 5+ years of relevant industry experience and have built automation software that runs in production, not only configured bots in an RPA product.

- You write strong TypeScript or similar 

- You have automated Windows desktop applications with UI Automation, plus at least one of Java Access Bridge, SAP GUI Scripting or browser automation over CDP, and native interop (Node native addons, C# or C++).

- You have experience with image-based automation over Citrix or RDP (OCR, screen anchors), or a strong wish to learn it. UiPath or Blue Prism developers with Citrix or computer-vision experience who now want to build the engine are very welcome.

- You know how to keep automations reliable in production: monitoring, failure handling, updates, and testing against apps you can't run in CI.

- You communicate clearly in English with technical and non-technical people, and you're comfortable working with German-language software.

- You analyze problems thoroughly and drive them to resolution.

- Nice to have: experience with OCR, document extraction or speech-to-text; healthcare or HIS integration experience; knowledge of GDPR and sensitive data; spoken German, which helps during rollout with hospital IT.

Not a perfect match on every point? We care more about shared drive and a real sense of mission than about ticking every box.

If this sounds like your kind of challenge, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Senior AI Engineer

description:

Inato is a Tech for Good company striving to bring clinical research to each and every patient, regardless of who they are or where they live. To do this, we’ve built an AI-powered platform that changes how pharmaceutical companies and doctors around the world collaborate to bring medical breakthroughs to patients. Leading companies and over 5,500 research sites rely on Inato to increase patient access, improve representation in trials, and deliver life-changing treatments to patients faster.

Drug development is a challenging, intellectually complex, and rewarding endeavor. We are a growing team of passionate pharmaceutical experts, software and AI engineers, professional services members, and many more—all bringing their unique perspectives to solve the challenges facing clinical research.

Inato is a recipient of Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies, Fierce Healthcare’s Fierce 15, and Built In's Best Places to Work 2025 and 2026.

🧑‍💻 The Role

We are looking for a dedicated and creative AI Engineer to join our team. As an essential contributor to our mission of transforming healthcare, you'll play a leading role in building AI-driven solutions that directly influence clinical research and, ultimately, improve patient care. We’ve already deployed multiple AI use cases in production, and your skills will be crucial in pushing the boundaries of healthcare AI.

💊 Responsibilities

In this role, you'll take on complex challenges that will stretch your abilities and creativity:

- Choose and orchestrate the right models to process and analyze multimodal data

- Design and implement cutting-edge RAG techniques to efficiently handle large medical documents and patient histories

- Build agentic systems to revolutionize key aspects of drug development such as patient recruitment or site selection

- Work closely with cross-functional teams (software engineers, product managers, data engineers) to seamlessly integrate AI into our platform

- Implement robust and scalable pipelines that meet production-grade engineering standards

Here are some examples of projects you might work on:

- Our prescreening tool: an app relying on the latest reasoning models and visual RAG to accelerate patient recruitment. It's already being used across hundreds of clinical sites to assess patient eligibility at scale. You may find more on this in our publication: https://arxiv.org/abs/2503.15374 

- Our site selection agent : an agentic assistant coupled with a mathematical optimizer to assist pharmaceutical sponsors in their search for efficient clinical sites and find the right mix of sites for every study

💊 Qualifications

- Several years of engineering experience with machine learning, data science, or AI at the centre of your work, not alongside it.

- You’ve shipped LLM-based features (OpenAI, Anthropic, RAG setup, agent setup, LLM observability tools etc.) that real users use, and you’ve lived with them afterwards: fixed them when they broke, iterated when they underperformed, watched how people actually used them.

- Python proficiency

- Strong problem-solving skills

- Strong communication skills, oral and written, both English and French

- Strong product mindset able to challenge the product roadmap directly with our CPO

- Knowledge about LLM’s evaluation challenges

- Ability to autonomously deliver clean and production-ready code

🤩 Good fits we see often

- ML engineers and data scientists who moved into LLM work as it matured. 

- Researchers who moved into production. 

- Software engineers who went deep on AI and stayed there.

😕 Probably not a fit

- your AI work has been research, prototypes or POCs with nothing shipped and maintained in production.

- you’ve spent most of your career in software engineering and shipped your first AI feature in the last year.

Our mission is to make clinical trials more accessible and inclusive. We value diverse backgrounds and experiences, bringing together industry veterans with fresh perspectives to advance the clinical trials industry.

title: Senior Sales Engineer, France

Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale. 

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. This means a successful Sales Engineer at Samsara will develop a thorough understanding of IoT hardware and sensors, hands-on installation/deployment scenarios, carrier networks, cloud infrastructure, and third-party system integrations (via our open API) to ensure the proper technical solution is presented to our customers.

- Work in multiple levels of the technology stack.

- 4+ years experience working with customers in a pre-sales, customer success, or customer/product support capacity.

- Ability to influence stakeholders based on your technical sales acumen and a solid understanding of business processes and change management.

- Ability to explain complex technical concepts to non-technical audiences.

- Knowledge of MEDDIC/BANT/CoM and/or Value Selling sales concepts.

- Previous experience managing hardware and/or software product evaluations.

- Basic understanding of electronics and electrical systems.

- Experience with the following concepts: technical consulting, cloud software, cloud-connected hardware, computer networking, business systems integration, automation, and control systems.

- Fluent in French and English

- Work experience in task automation scripting and transferring data between systems using Bash, Python, JavaScript, or equivalent language.

- Work experience building solutions leveraging open APIs.

- Understanding of vehicle diagnostic systems, including Controller Area Networks (CAN bus) and Power Take Off (PTO) applications.

- Hobbyist interest in working with things driven by electronic systems (car audio installation/classic car restoration, home automation, building things with Raspberry Pi, Arduino, etc.).

- Experience working with product teams internally and feature request processes.

We’re building in a legacy industry and moving gigawatt-hours of electrons in the real world, but we operate at lightning speed, and we’re growing the team to meet customer demand.

We’re proud to be supported by world-leading investors, including Energize Capital and Accel.

We’re looking for a commercially sharp, highly autonomous operator to drive Axle’s commercial success in the German market. 

Axle has quickly become the leader in our operational markets, and we’re now looking to expand our reach internationally. Our goal is to become the go-to platform for energy flexibility globally, and we’re hiring the person to make that happen.

This role will assess Axle’s participation in German markets and business models from first principles: diving deep into regulations, modelling revenue-per-asset, and trialling new propositions at pace.

You speak German and fluent English. Other European languages are also an asset.

What you will be doing 

- Owning Axle’s commercial results in the German market: pipeline, revenue and partner success

- Winning new customers end-to-end, from first conversation through to commercial close, and setting partners up to generate meaningful revenue

- Driving go-to-market execution with partners, including value propositions, pricing, customer segmentation and launch strategy

- Continuing to sharpen our view of where the value is and which markets and business models are accessible to us

Bi-annual retreats to strengthen team connection & shared purpose.

The opportunity to directly shape the future of energy markets and accelerate the transition to a low-carbon world.

title: Senior Gen AI Software Engineer
description:
Liftoff is a leading AI-powered performance marketing platform for the mobile app economy. Our end-to-end technology stack helps app marketers acquire and retain high-value users, while enabling publishers to maximize revenue across programmatic and direct demand.

Liftoff’s solutions, including Accelerate, Direct, Monetize, Intelligence, and Vungle Exchange, support over 6,600 mobile businesses across 74 countries in sectors such as gaming, social, finance, ecommerce, and entertainment. Founded in 2012 and headquartered in Redwood City, CA, Liftoff has a diverse, global presence.

Join Liftoff as a Senior Gen AI Software Engineer and help shape the future of ad tech. As a key member of our Gen AI team, you’ll design and build AI-powered products for our demand-side business, helping teams turn complex data into better decisions and meaningful customer growth.

You’ll work across the stack, building intelligent systems and data pipelines in Python, alongside the TypeScript and React experiences that bring those capabilities to users. You’ll partner closely with product, engineering, and customer-facing teams to identify high-impact opportunities, move quickly from prototype to production, and continuously improve what you ship.

This is a hands-on role for an engineer who enjoys working at the intersection of AI, product, and software engineering. You’ll help define how Liftoff applies modern AI to real business problems, balancing experimentation with the judgment and engineering discipline needed to build useful, reliable products.

This role is ideal for an engineer who thrives in ambiguity, enjoys experimenting with new technology, and is motivated by turning promising AI capabilities into products that create real value. You’ll tackle complex problems, validate new approaches, and drive meaningful improvements across Liftoff.

WHAT YOU'LL DO 

- Own generative AI product capabilities end to end, from understanding user workflows and prototyping an approach through implementation, rollout, measurement, and ongoing improvement.

- Rapidly prototype and validate AI solutions, using focused experiments to test user value and technical feasibility, then turn what works into production-ready capabilities.

- Build agentic workflows that can reason over campaign, customer, creative, and performance data, use well-defined tools, produce structured results, and hand control back to a person when appropriate.

- Partner closely with decision makers and subject matter experts to understand their workflows, constraints, and business context, then integrate AI agents into daily work in practical and useful ways.

- Design how AI systems access and use relevant information, including the data, tools, and instructions needed to produce useful grounded results.

- Build the systems that make AI workflows reliable in production, including tool use, state management, failure recovery, and appropriate boundaries for human review.

- Define clear, testable interfaces between models and software so uncertain model behavior can be handled safely within dependable product systems.

- Develop evaluation systems that measure whether AI features accomplish the intended task, using realistic examples and an appropriate combination of automated checks and human judgment.

- Build the instrumentation needed to understand quality, adoption, business impact, latency, cost, and failure modes in production.

- Apply appropriate safeguards for customer data, system access, and high-impact workflows.

- Build the Python services and TypeScript and React interfaces that turn these capabilities into cohesive products for customer facing teams.

- Evaluate new models and techniques pragmatically, adopting them when they materially improve product quality, capability, speed, or cost.

- Mentor other engineers and help establish shared practices for designing, testing, and operating AI-powered products.

WHO YOU ARE 

- Minimum Bachelors Degree and 8 yrs of relevant experience.

- You are a seasoned software engineer who has built and operated meaningful production products, ideally including zero-to-one work spanning backend services, data, and user interfaces.

- You have shipped LLM-powered or AI-assisted products beyond a demo and understand the practical challenges of reliability, context, tool use, provider changes, latency, cost, and changing model behavior.

- You are highly proficient in Python and comfortable working in TypeScript and React, with strong fundamentals in API design, data modeling, SQL, and testing.

- You understand how to build the broader system around a model, including its data, tools, instructions, permissions, feedback loops, and measures of quality.

- You can define success criteria, investigate failures, and use testing, feedback, and production signals to improve AI experiences over time.

- You exercise strong product and engineering judgment, choosing when a problem calls for traditional software, an LLM-powered approach, or a thoughtful combination of both.

- You communicate complex technical ideas clearly and collaborate effectively with domain experts and non-technical partners.

- You are comfortable working through ambiguity, making informed decisions with incomplete information, and changing direction when evidence shows a better path.

- You are a lifelong learner with strong but flexible opinions, and you thrive on giving and receiving constructive feedback.

Helpful, but not required

- Experience as an early engineer, startup founder, or in a similarly high-ownership environment where you moved quickly from ambiguous problems to shipped products.

- Experience with advertising technology, campaign optimization, performance marketing, analytics products, or other data-rich B2B software.

Location: 

The preferred location for the role is in Pacific Standard Time Zone. This role is eligible for full-time remote work in one of our entities: CA, CO, ID, IL, FL, GA, MA, MI, MN, MO, NJ, NV, NY, OR, PA, TX, UT, and WA.

We are a remote-first company with US hubs in Redwood City, Los Angeles, and New York City. 

Travel Expectations: 

We offer several opportunities for in-person team gatherings, including but not limited to project meetings, regional meetups, and company-wide events. We expect our employees to attend these gatherings at least once per quarter. These gatherings provide essential opportunities for collaboration, communication, and team building.

Compensation :

Liftoff offers all employees a full compensation package that includes equity and health/vision/dental benefits associated with your country of residence. Base compensation will vary based on the candidate's location and experience. 

The following are our base salary ranges for multiple levels:

- SF Bay Area, Los Angeles/Orange County, NYC, Seattle: $230,000 - $270,000

- All other cities and towns in our approved states: $211,000 - $248,000

#LI-VM1

Liftoff offers a fast-paced, collaborative, and innovative work environment where employees are empowered to grow and make an impact. We’re shaping the future of the mobile app ecosystem—join us and help accelerate what’s next.

Liftoff’s compensation strategy includes competitive salaries, equity, and benefits designed to support employee well-being and performance. We benchmark compensation based on role, level, and location to ensure fairness and market alignment. Benefits may include medical coverage, wellness stipends, and additional perks based on your country of residence.

Liftoff is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and applicants regardless of race, ethnicity, national origin, age, marital status, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, religion, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Agency and Third Party Recruiter Notice: 

Liftoff does not accept unsolicited resumes from individual recruiters or third-party recruiting agencies in response to job postings. No fee will be paid to third parties who submit unsolicited candidates directly to our hiring managers or Recruiting Team. All candidates must be submitted via our Applicant Tracking System by approved Liftoff vendors who have been expressly requested to make a submission by our Recruiting Team for a specific job opening. title: Software Test Engineer 80–100%
description:
As our Software Test Engineer at machineMD in Bern, you’ll bring your engineering skills to a practical challenge: making complex systems easier to test. You’ll design and build test automation, connect tools and technologies, and explore how agentic workflows can improve the way we work. Our existing infrastructure gives you a starting point, with the freedom to extend it and introduce new approaches. You’ll work alongside developers, requirements engineers, and testers, taking responsibility for solutions from design to daily use.

About machineMD

We’re on a mission to radically improve the measurement of brain function through standardized, automated, quantitative exams. Our signature product, neos™, is the world’s first non-invasive neuro-ophthalmoscope for fast, automated assessment of eye movements and pupils. Founded at the University Hospital of Bern, Switzerland, we’ve grown into a startup of 25 engineers, clinicians, scientists, and specialists working side by side. We aim to bring the diagnostic quality of highly trained specialists into secondary and primary care settings everywhere.

The Role

You’ll help us understand how neos™ behaves when its components work together—and where they fail. You’ll design and build the test systems, agentic workflows, and tooling that make complex behaviour reproducible and failures easier to diagnose. You’ll work alongside developers and use the domain expertise and manual testing provided by requirements engineers and testers.

- Pragmatic Improvements – assess our current testing setup with the team, identify the biggest weaknesses, and tackle them step by step. Build on what works, try useful approaches, and let a broader test concept grow from the improvements you put into practice.

- Engineer the Next Generation of Test Automation – build intelligent, agent-powered systems that redefine how complex software is tested. Go beyond UI testing, architect autonomous workflows, experiment with cutting-edge AI technologies, and turn bold ideas into production-ready solutions. Own the test automation stack. Build, break, innovate.

- Test Infrastructure – build on and improve our physical and software-based test environments. Introduce tools and setups where they make testing more effective, and keep them documented so tests remain repeatable and usable by others.

- Coordination & Code Quality – work hands-on with developers to implement automation, coordinate contributions, and review the quality of test code. Connect individual improvements so our testing becomes more consistent and easier to extend over time.

- Verification & Validation – contribute to V&V plans, protocols, reports, and evidence, and coordinate activities with the relevant specialists. Help keep testing, requirements, and documentation aligned in a medical device environment.

What We Look For

Experience

- Solid practical experience in software engineering, including designing, implementing, debugging, and maintaining software. You can understand existing codebases and develop clear, well-structured solutions that others can maintain and extend.

- Experience with some of our core technologies (Python, C#/.NET, C++ and Flutter/Dart) is a plus. Python and pytest are particularly useful for test automation, and you’re willing to learn the technologies needed for the task.

- Practical experience developing automated tests across different system levels, with the programming skills to implement, understand, and review test code. Experience building or integrating agentic workflows is a plus.

- Experience with verification and validation of medical devices or familiarity with ISO 13485 is a plus.

Qualifications

- Solid software testing fundamentals at ISTQB Foundation Level or equivalent knowledge, including test planning, test design, and requirements coverage.

- Vocational training or a higher degree in computer science, software engineering, medical informatics, or a related technical field.

- Fluent English (minimum strong B2, ideally C1); German or French language skills are a plus for on-site collaboration.

Eligibility to work in Switzerland (Swiss/EU/EFTA work permit).

How You Work

- Systems Thinker – you want to understand how neos™ works as a whole, from its software and hardware to the tests and data behind it. You choose practical improvements as our product and testing continue to develop.

- Curiosity & a Detective’s Instinct – you notice when something doesn’t quite add up and enjoy following the clues. You question assumptions, explore unusual scenarios, and keep digging until you can explain and reproduce what you’ve found.

- Close the Gaps – you enjoy getting your hands dirty and following a problem across disciplines. When progress depends on something outside your usual remit, you’re willing to learn and lend a hand.

- Collaborative Spirit – you work closely with colleagues, share what you know and what you’re unsure about, and address difficult topics openly. You listen with curiosity, give and receive candid feedback, and make room for different perspectives.

- Shaper Mentality & Growth Mindset – you want to shape how testing works, take responsibility, and build missing skills quickly. You’re curious about neurodiagnostics and ready to learn from experts and real-world use cases.

Working at machineMD

Located in Bern, Switzerland, we thrive on collaborative, in-person energy, while offering the flexibility you need to do your best work.

Available for roughly 80% of your time on-site in Bern and committed to our weekly anchor day on Monday.

We are united by the Four Pillars of Integrity: Radical Responsibility, Feeling Our Feelings, Candor and Clear Agreements. These are not just words on a wall; they guide how we:

- Own our choices (Radical Responsibility)

- Name and honour our emotions (Feeling Our Feelings)

- Speak and listen with honesty (Candor)

- Make and keep clear commitments (Clear Agreements)

Living these principles keeps us “whole”, fully alive, and brimming with the energy needed to build world-class diagnostic tools.

Life’s too short to work on boring stuff. If you want to connect ideas, people, and technology to advance brain diagnostics at the frontlines in a dynamic startup environment, let’s talk!

How to Apply

Send your CV and a short note about a project or task from your career that you enjoyed a lot, and explain why.

We welcome applications from all qualified individuals regardless of gender, age, background, or orientation. Direct applications only. No recruiters, please.

We’re excited to meet you!

title: Enterprise Success Manager, NL (EMEA)
description:
About Mistral 

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

The Role 

As an Enterprise Success Manager at Mistral, you own what happens to our most strategic enterprise accounts after the build: you make deployed AI stick in real workflows, keep production ARR healthy, defend renewals, and source the expansion signals Sales closes.

Mistral's Solutions teams create high-value AI use cases with our customers. Your job is to make those investments successful beyond delivery — adopting what has been built, operating it with confidence, measuring its business impact, and scaling value across the organization. You will work with customer sponsors, business teams, IT and security stakeholders, and across Mistral with Solutions, Product, Engineering and Support.

This is not a high-volume, ticket-queue customer success role. Portfolios are small and deep. It calls for a strategic account mindset, the technical judgment to navigate complex deployment environments, and the energy to build the customer success function as Mistral grows.

You will join on one of two tracks (and can move between them): 

- Adoption track — embedded in flagship transformations while Solutions is still delivering. You own the adoption and change-management motion around the build: user waves, enablement, champions, training programs, and the measurement that proves value is landing.

- Operational track — you take accounts through a structured handover once Solutions completes delivery, and own the run phase end-to-end: operational health, value realization, renewals, and expansion signals.

In both tracks you operate in close partnership with Solutions: they deliver and hand over; you own post-handover; they re-engage on expansion signals. Occasionally, account teams will also pull you into late-stage pre-sales — authoring the customer training and scale-up plan that gives a buyer confidence in the rollout, a motion already credited in a major European win.

What You Will Do 

Own the customer success and value plan

- Build a clear view of each account's objectives, stakeholders, deployed use cases, commitments and risks. Translate it into a shared success plan with owners, milestones and measurable outcomes.

- Establish a practical operating cadence with customer sponsors, business owners, IT and delivery teams. Lead success reviews that make progress, risks, decisions and next steps clear.

- Define a baseline and track the outcomes that matter for each use case: adoption and usage against entitled seats, customer satisfaction, operational health and business impact. Turn the evidence into a clear value narrative.

Make deployment realities part of the success plan

- Understand how each customer's deployment model — on-premises, VPC or serverless — affects the products and use cases they can access, operate and scale. Validate the specifics with the technical teams rather than assuming feature parity or identical operating models.

- Identify the practical implications of deployment choices: security and data requirements, access and integrations, release and upgrade cadence, available features, capacity, observability and support processes. Explain the trade-offs clearly to customer and Mistral stakeholders.

- Translate those constraints into an actionable adoption plan: align enablement and release communications with the version the customer actually runs, account for security approvals and upgrade windows, and agree how to measure usage when telemetry is limited.

- Spot risks early, qualify their impact on adoption, renewal or value, and coordinate the right Solutions, Product, Engineering or Support owners to resolve them. Set clear expectations without making unvalidated technical or roadmap commitments.

Drive adoption, autonomy and sustained value

- Help customer teams move from a delivered use case to regular, effective use. Identify the users, workflows and change-management needs that determine whether it sticks.

- Coordinate onboarding, training, product updates and hands-on enablement with the right Mistral and customer teams. Develop customer champions and train-the-trainer motions so adoption scales beyond direct Mistral involvement.

- Prepare the transition from delivery to run: clarify operational ownership, support and escalation paths, and the resources users need to succeed independently.

- Monitor adoption and customer health, investigate where usage or value is falling short, and lead a coordinated plan to address the causes.

Defend and grow the commercial relationship

- Own the renewal motion for your accounts: know every renewal date, the auto vs non-auto renewal terms, and the risk story behind each one. Run the renewal play early — no surprises at renewal time.

- Track and improve account NRR. Identify new use cases, teams and expansion opportunities, and share them with the account team grounded in demonstrated value.

- Lead business reviews with the account team: value delivered, risks owned, decisions needed, roadmap asks.

Bring the customer voice into Mistral

- Gather and qualify feedback from users, technical teams and sponsors. Distinguish enablement needs from product gaps, deployment constraints and support issues, and route each to the right owner.

- Track important requests and communicate progress and limitations back to the customer, while Product and Engineering retain ownership of product and technical decisions.

Build the company as well as the account

- Create the playbooks, success plans, handover practices and measurement approaches that are missing. Test them with customers, improve them, and make them reusable across accounts.

- Bring structure to ambiguity: identify what needs to happen, make a plan, mobilize the right people and follow through — without waiting for a perfect process or detailed instructions.

- Roughly a fifth of your time is protected, rotating build time for exactly this work; it is part of the job, not extra to it.

What We're Looking For 

- 5+ years of experience in customer-facing roles, such as Customer Success, Delivery/Implementation, or Solutions Consulting, ideally in a technical AI or SaaS environment.

- Experience owning outcomes for enterprise customers of technical products or deployed solutions — adoption and commercial outcomes (retention, renewal, expansion), not relationship management or activity reporting.

- Strong technical fluency in enterprise deployment models. You can identify what a deployment type (on-premises, VPC, serverless) means for available features, telemetry, upgrades and security reviews, and you validate specifics with technical teams instead of assuming parity.

- Ability to engage credibly with architects, engineers, IT and security teams, while translating technical trade-offs into clear business implications for executives and users. You know when to bring in a deeper technical expert.

- Strong ownership and builder energy. You have created structure or improved a process in an ambiguous, fast-moving environment and are motivated to build a company, not wait for clear directions.

- Excellent communication, stakeholder management and execution skills. You align teams without formal authority, surface risks early and drive decisions through to completion.

- Analytical and commercially minded: you can define meaningful success metrics, assess customer health, and are comfortable carrying renewal and NRR accountability.

- Fluent English; professional French strongly preferred (a significant share of our enterprise base is French-speaking).

Nice to have

- Experience with AI, machine learning, data platforms or complex enterprise software, including production deployments in regulated or security-sensitive environments.

- Experience working alongside deployment, engineering or professional services teams on custom use cases, and the transition from implementation to ongoing operation.

- Experience building adoption, change-management or customer education programs across large organizations.

- Experience at a forward-deployed, solutions-led company.

What We Offer 

We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks.

For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page .

Privacy Policy 

Your privacy matters to us. You can learn more about how we handle your personal data in our Applicant Privacy Policy .

Experience with credit reporting dispute workflows, e-OSCAR, Metro 2 format, and investigating escalations from customer support teams

Experience with dbt, Redshift, PostgreSQL, AWS, and workflow scheduling or orchestration tools

title: Software Engineer AI Tooling

About the Role

Every team member receives an annual education allowance to spend on learningâcourses, books, conferences, or anything that supports your growth.

About the Team 

Supabase was born-remote and open-source-first. We believe our globally distributed team is our secret weapon in building tools developers love.

title: Senior Software Engineer, Developer Experience
description:
Thumbtack helps millions of people confidently care for their homes. 

Thumbtack is the one app you need to take care of and improve your home — from personalized guidance to AI tools and a best-in-class hiring experience. Every day in every county of the U.S., people turn to Thumbtack to complete urgent repairs, seasonal maintenance and bigger improvements. We help homeowners know which projects to do, when to do them and who to hire from our growing community of 300,000 local service businesses. If making an impact inspires you, join us. Imagine what we’ll build together.

About the Developer Experience Team 

The Developer Experience (DevEx) team makes Thumbtack's ~250 engineers more productive. We own the AI-powered developer workflows, cloud development environments, and internal developer platform the whole engineering org builds on. We're small and senior: a four-person team in Productivity Engineering, alongside Mobile Infra, Frontend Infrastructure, and Design Systems Engineering. We partner closely with engineers across the company to find their pain points and ship solutions. You can read more about our engineering culture on the Thumbtack Engineering Blog .

The challenge 

We're building the infrastructure for an AI-native engineering organization, and every stream here is active work today: agentic developer tools like Claude Code, Codex, and Cursor, backed by a library of skills that encode Thumbtack-specific knowledge; a catalog of Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers that make our internal tools AI-accessible; and cloud development environments (CDEs) built for humans and agents alike. Alongside these, we're modernizing the Web and CLI tooling layers engineers reach for every day. A single improvement we ship can move dozens of teams forward.

What you’ll do 

- 
Build the platforms behind agentic developer workflows: roll out the tools the org builds on (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor) and ship the skills, plugins, and MCP servers that run across them.

- 
Design and build the product surfaces engineers and AI agents reach for daily: self-service workflows in our Backstage developer portal, our developer CLI, IDE integrations, and the framework engineers use to build and deploy their own agents.

- 
Own and evolve our Cloud Development Environment (CDE) platform for both human developers and AI agents.

- 
Improve the build systems, CI/CD pipelines, test infrastructure, and observability the whole org depends on.

- 
Prototype and evaluate new AI developer tools as they land, and decide what to adopt, configure, and scale across the engineering org.

In order to be successful, you must bring 

- 
Demonstrated experience building developer infrastructure, DevEx, or platform tools that other engineers depend on, from CDE rollouts and internal CLIs to MCP servers and build/CI at 100+ engineer scale.

Strong systems thinking: you reason about build pipelines, CI/CD, dev environments, and test infrastructure as interconnected systems, not isolated tools.

- 
Hands-on experience with agentic developer tools like Claude Code, Cursor, or Codex, and considered opinions about their limits, where they help, and how to scale their use.

- 
Fluency in the languages our tooling is built in: Go and Python for CLIs, services, MCP servers, and Slackbots, plus TypeScript and React for the web UIs.

6+ years of industry experience in software engineering, including cross-team projects with measurable impact on engineering productivity.

title: Team Lead Software Engineer
description:
We’re Capital on Tap 👋
💳 Capital on Tap started because small businesses were underserved. Big banks were slow, their products weren't fit for purpose, and small business owners often couldn't access what they needed. We set out to fix that.

Today we're a financial platform - not just a credit card company. We offer a best-in-class business credit card, SME-focused spend management platform, a savings product that hit £1 billion in funds within its first year, and a growing suite of tools and financial products that make running a small business easier. 

1,000+ employees, £20bn in annual card spend, 200,000+ customers, 17,000+ Trustpilot reviews averaging 4.7 stars, and we're profitable. We’ve done a pretty good job so far, but we’re just getting started! 

We opened our first Portuguese office in Porto in autumn 2025, and in less than a year it has grown to a team of 50. Lisbon is the next step. We're opening our first office in the city and looking for engineers to join as founding members of the team, helping shape how we build, hire and work here from day one.

🏢The role starts out fully remote. Once our Lisbon office is open, it will move to a hybrid set-up of two days a week on site.

Salary: €70,000 - 90,000

What You’ll Be Doing 

We're looking for an Engineering Team Lead to lead one of our product engineering teams here at Capital on Tap.

This is a people-first leadership role. You'll be responsible for the growth, wellbeing, and performance of a team of engineers, while staying technically credible enough to shape direction, remove blockers, and raise the bar on quality. You won't be the best coder in the room you'll be the person who makes the whole room better.

If you're an experienced Team Lead Engineer looking to own a team in a scaling fintech, this role is built for you.

What You'll Own

Your team. Hiring, developing, and retaining engineers. Running 1:1s that actually matter. Spotting who's ready to grow and creating the space for them to do it.

Delivery. Partnering with Product and QA to plan and ship reliably not by micromanaging, but by removing obstacles, managing risk, and keeping the team focused on what matters.

Culture. Setting the tone for how the team communicates, gives feedback, and holds itself accountable. Building psychological safety without sacrificing standards.

Technical credibility. You won't be heads-down in the codebase every day, but you'll understand the trade-offs your team is navigating architecture decisions, technical debt, build vs buy and contribute meaningfully to those conversations.

What We're Looking For

Leadership first. You've managed engineers before and have a point of view on what good looks like. You know how to have hard conversations, give developmental feedback, and motivate people.

Technical foundation in .NET. Our backend is C#/.NET Core and you'll need enough depth to earn trust with your engineers, review decisions, and spot risks. You don't need to be across every layer of the stack you need to be honest about what you know and curious about what you don't.

Product mindset. You think about engineering in the context of business outcomes, not just technical correctness. You can push back on scope, advocate for quality, and translate between engineering and non-technical stakeholders.

Comfort with ambiguity. Capital on Tap is growing. Priorities shift. We want someone who creates clarity for their team rather than waiting for it.

Nice to Have

- Experience with Azure cloud development

- Familiarity with React or other frontend frameworks

- Background in financial services or fintech

Diversity & Inclusion 🌈
We welcome, consider and encourage applications from anyone who shares our commitment to inclusivity. Join us in creating a space where authenticity thrives, and everyone can do their best work.

Interview Process 🤝 

- First stage: 30 minute intro call with Talent Partner

- Second stage: 60 minute "Tech Chat" & Values Interview with an Engineering Manager & People Partner

- Third stage: 60 minute Code Pairing with our Engineering Team

- Final stage: 60 minute Case Study with Product & Engineering + 60 minute Good to Great Interview with our CTO

Great Work Deserves Great Perks

🎁 Anniversary Rewards (€280, €570, €860, 4-week fully paid sabbatical)

🏖️ 36 days holiday (inclusive of public holidays with public holidays carried over if they fall on a weekend)

title: Full-Stack Software Engineer
description:
Our Mission

At Laelaps AI, we believe robotics is entering a transformative decade, much like the arrival of the internet. Advances in AI, cloud computing, and hardware are reshaping what autonomous systems can do. Our mission is to build the intelligent software that powers physical security in the real world - enabling robots and sensors to handle dangerous and critical tasks that humans shouldn't have to. By engineering the orchestration layer for intelligent security, we aim to create a world that is safer, more secure, and more resilient.

We're a strong founding team based in Zurich, backed by visionary investors and advisors. We are engineering the future of security today!

THE ROLE

Your work will span the full data lifecycle, from architecting resilient ETL/ELT pipelines and developing real-time and batch data integrations to automating reporting, reducing technical debt, and enabling advanced analytics. Sr. Data Engineers at Carrot are operational stewards and technical mentors, driving improvements in system maturity, cost efficiency, automation, and collaborative practices.

- Architect, build, test, deploy, and maintain scalable, automated ETL/ELT pipelines using Python, dbt, and orchestration tools such as Prefect and Airflow

- Orchestrate data workflows with custom scheduling, alerting, dependency management, monitoring, and error resolution

- Automate manual reporting and operational tasks, building robust, reusable pipeline components that reduce operational overhead

- Strengthen data quality, lineage, governance, and documentation practices across key data domains

- Mentor teammates and reinforce best practices in version control, code review, and structured workflow management

What Success Looks Like 

In your first 12–18 months, you will have:

- Taken end-to-end ownership of core pipelines and integrations, with measurable improvements in reliability, data recency, and cost efficiency

- Automated high-effort manual workflows, reducing operational risk and freeing capacity for higher-value engineering work

We're looking for engineers with strong software engineering fundamentals and hands-on experience building, scaling, and operating the platforms and infrastructure that enable machine learning in production. In this role, you’ll lead complex platform work from business context through production outcomes, combining hands-on engineering, architectural judgment, production ownership, and mentorship. title: Data Engineer II, Credit Reporting
description:
Headquarters: Turkey

URL: https://sezzle.com 

The salary range for this role is $2,800 - $4,500 per month (Gross in USD) 

About Sezzle: 

With a mission to financially empower the next generation, Sezzle is revolutionizing the shopping experience beyond payments, blending cutting-edge tech with seamless, interest-free installment plans that make shopping smarter and more accessible. We’re not just transforming payments; we’re redefining how people discover, interact with, and purchase the things they love while driving real impact on merchant sales through increased conversions and higher order values. As we continue to shape the future of fintech and retail, we’re building an innovative, dynamic team passionate about creating more than just a transaction but a truly unique shopping journey. If you’re excited about pushing boundaries in tech and delivering a game-changing experience for consumers and merchants alike, come join us at Sezzle and help create the future of shopping!

About the Role: 

We are seeking a talented and motivated, best-in-class Data Engineer II. This role presents an exciting opportunity to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment within a rapidly growing team, with abundant prospects for career advancement. This position will own the data pipelines, transformations, and reporting processes that support accurate, complete, and timely furnishing of customer account information to credit bureaus.

This role presents an opportunity to work in a fast-paced, high growth environment while taking hands-on ownership of a critical customer-facing data function. You will dig into account data and code, debug SQL and Python workflows, and carry issues from investigation through verified resolution. You will partner with Customer Service to resolve technical dispute escalations, with Compliance to apply approved reporting requirements, and with Engineering when a fix is needed in production services or the consumer app. We are looking for an independent problem solver who can manage recurring reporting operations while improving the systems behind them.

What You’ll Do: 

- Own recurring credit bureau furnishing operations, including data preparation, validation, submissions, bureau feedback, exception resolution, and reconciliation 

- Build, maintain, and debug SQL transformations, Python scripts, and data pipelines that produce credit reporting data

- Trace discrepancies from account activity and source records through transformation logic to furnished outputs; identify root causes and implement lasting fixes 

- Investigate escalations from Customer Service, explain what happened to account data and what should be reported under approved policies, and provide evidence to support their dispute responses 

- Identify all accounts affected by reporting defects, implement corrections and controlled reprocessing, and verify the resulting reporting outcomes 

- Develop automated tests, reconciliations, monitoring, and alerts to catch inaccurate, incomplete, duplicate, or unexpected reporting before submission 

- Partner with Engineering on defects in production services or the consumer app, providing reproducible examples, affected-account analysis, and clear requirements; validate fixes through the reporting pipeline 

- Work with Compliance to translate approved reporting requirements into technical rules and escalate ambiguous reporting scenarios 

- Document reporting logic, data lineage, procedures, and incident resolutions so the process is repeatable and can be supported by others 

What We Look For: 

- Degree in computer science, engineering, data science, or a related quantitative discipline

- 3+ years of relevant experience in data engineering or software engineering, including hands-on ownership of production data pipelines and operational workflows

- Advanced SQL skills, including complex joins, account-level reconciliation, data profiling, and troubleshooting transformation logic

- Strong Python skills, including the ability to read unfamiliar code, debug existing scripts, and implement maintainable fixes

- Demonstrated ability to independently investigate ambiguous problems, prioritize recurring operations and incidents, and carry issues through to verified resolution 

- Experience with version control, code review, automated testing, monitoring, and safe deployment and reprocessing of data workflows

- Excellent problem-solving skills, with a track record of tracing data defects across systems and preventing recurrence

- Strong business judgment and communication skills; able to explain technical findings to Customer Service and Compliance and work effectively with Engineering 

- Fluent in English

- Demonstrated experience working with Claude or equivalent large language model tools is required; candidates must be comfortable leveraging AI to enhance productivity, research, and communication.

Preferred Knowledge and Skills: 

- 
Experience with credit reporting dispute workflows, e-OSCAR, Metro 2 format, and investigating escalations from customer support teams

- 
Experience with dbt, Redshift, PostgreSQL, AWS, and workflow scheduling or orchestration tools

- 
Experience in consumer lending, servicing, payments, financial services, banking, fintech, or BNPL

The Tech You’ll Work With: 

- Python

- Redshift, PostgreSQL

- Data build tool (dbt) 

- WS, G Suite, Mac

- Coding agents Claude, ChatGPT

Interview Process: 

- Application submitted (you are here)

- Wonderlic test (30-40 min)

- Interview with recruiters (30 min)

- Online coding assessment focused on SQL, Python, and debugging

- Verbal case study interview. Walk through a credit reporting discrepancy, trace the data and code, and explain how you would correct and prevent the issue.

- Verbal behavioral interview. Share examples of independently resolving data incidents, improving reliability, and partnering with Engineering and Customer Service.

- Offer

About You: 

- You have relentlessly high standards - many people may think your standards are unreasonably high. You are continually raising the bar and driving those around you to deliver great results. You make sure that defects do not get sent down the line and that problems are fixed so they stay fixed.

- You’re not bound by convention - your success—and much of the fun—lies in developing new ways to do things

- You need action - speed matters in business. Many decisions and actions are reversible and do not need extensive study. We value calculated risk-taking.

- You earn trust - you listen attentively, speak candidly, and treat others respectfully.

- You have backbone; disagree, then commit - you can respectfully challenge decisions when you disagree, even when doing so is uncomfortable or exhausting. You have conviction and are tenacious. You do not compromise for the sake of social cohesion. Once a decision is determined, you commit wholly.

- You deliver results - you focus on the key inputs and deliver them with the right quality and in a timely fashion. Despite setbacks, you rise to the occasion and never settle.

What Makes Working at Sezzle Awesome? 

At Sezzle, we are more than just brilliant engineers, passionate data enthusiasts, out-of-the-box thinkers, and determined innovators; we are skilled musicians, yogis, cyclists, chefs, golfers, dog-lovers, and rock-climbers. We believe in surrounding ourselves with not only the best and the brightest individuals, but those that are unique and purpose-driven in all that they do. Our culture is not defined by a certain set of perks designed to give the illusion of the traditional startup culture, but rather, it is the visible example living in every employee that we hire.

#Li-remote #Full-time

You'll partner directly with internal teams like Marketing, Sales, Support, Operations and Finance to find high-leverage processes, then design, ship and iterate on agents that take real work off their plates. title: Software Engineer, AI Coding Tasks

We're looking for experienced software engineers to build AI coding tasks from a codebase they know well. US$1,000 per task, and you can do as many tasks as you want.

Remote, any location. US$1,000 per task that passes review. Minimum of one task a week, about 10 hours a week.

How it works

- Apply. Complete a short screener interview and upload your resume.

- Propose. Once you're selected, pick a change from a repository you know and submit a short proposal. We approve it or suggest a better candidate.

- Build. In our platform, set up the repository as it was before the change, then write the brief, the correct solution and the grading checks.

- Stress-test. Try lazy, incorrect and shortcut solutions and make sure your checks catch them.

- Model testing. Run your task against leading AI models until strong models often fail but a skilled engineer can clearly solve it.

- Review. A reviewer checks your task and you revise it. Most tasks take more than one round.

- Next task. Once your task is accepted, start another.

Requirements

- 2+ years of professional software engineering

- Code merged into a public open-source repository, ideally one you know well. A private codebase you own may also qualify (not employer or client code)

Nice to have

- Deep expertise in one area, such as databases, compilers, distributed systems, security or infrastructure

- Experience building agent tasks or RL environments

Terms

- US$1,000 for each task that passes our quality review, paid directly to you

- Once your proposal is qualified, you sign Askable's contract and accept its terms

- The work is used for AI training. The change and your solution must be your own, and you must be free to license them to us

- Don't publish the work anywhere: no public pull request or public fork

What you'll do

- Build and improve agentic flows and their reusable parts with LangChain and LangGraph, including the Flow Registry.
